title.en: Volume 308 Biographies 95: Na Sutu, Yang Chaoceng, Xu Shilin, Shao Ji, Wang Shi, Yin Huiyi, Wang Shu, Fang Xian, Fang Gui, Feng Guangyu, Yang Xifu, Pan Siju, Hu Baoquan
title.raw: 卷308 列傳九十五 那苏图 杨超曾 徐士林 邵基 王师 尹会一 王恕 方显 方桂 冯光裕 杨锡绂 潘思榘 胡宝瑔

sentences.zh: =那蘇圖=那蘇圖，戴佳氏，字羲文，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Na Sutu, of the Daijia clan, style Xi Wen, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Na Sutu, of the Daijia clan, courtesy name Xi Wen, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十年，襲拖沙喇哈番世職，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year of Kangxi, he inherited the hereditary rank of tosara ha and was appointed a blue-laced bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year of the Kangxi reign, he inherited the hereditary rank of tosara ha and was appointed a blue-laced imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，四遷兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng, he was promoted four times to vice minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongzheng reign, he was promoted four times to vice minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 四年，出為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he went out as general of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, he was appointed general of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 八年，調奉天將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was transferred as general of Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, he was transferred to serve as general of Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，擢兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, he was elevated to minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign, he was promoted to minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 二年，調刑部，授兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was transferred to the Board of Punishments and appointed governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, he was transferred to the Board of Punishments and appointed governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 協辦吏部尚書顧琮請江、浙沿海設塘堡，复衛所，下督撫詳議。

translations.literal: Assistant Minister of Personnel Gu Cong requested that forts and bastions be established along the Jiangsu and Zhejiang coast and the guard posts restored; the order was sent down to the governor-generals and governors for detailed discussion.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong, assistant minister of the Board of Civil Appointments, petitioned to establish fortifications along the Jiangsu and Zhejiang coast and to restore the guard posts; the matter was referred to the governors and governor-generals for detailed deliberation.

sentences.zh: 三年，那蘇圖奏：「明沿海衛、所武事廢弛，我朝裁衛改營，江南有金山、柘林、青村、南匯、川沙、吳淞、劉河諸營，提督駐松江控制。

translations.literal: In the third year, Na Sutu memorialized: "Under the Ming, coastal guard posts and garrisons had fallen into military neglect. Our dynasty reduced the guard posts and reorganized them into garrisons. In Jiangnan there are the garrisons of Jinshan, Zhelin, Qingcun, Nanhui, Chuansha, Wusong, and Liuhe, with the provincial commander headquartered at Songjiang to oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Na Sutu memorialized: "Under the Ming, coastal guard posts and garrisons had fallen into decay. Our dynasty abolished those posts and reorganized them into garrisons. In Jiangnan there are garrisons at Jinshan, Zhelin, Qingcun, Nanhui, Chuansha, Wusong, and Liuhe, overseen by the provincial commander stationed at Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 崇明、狼山二鎮對峙海口，塘汛聲勢連絡，無庸復設衛、所。

translations.literal: The two garrison towns of Chongming and Langshan face each other across the river mouth, and the coastal patrol stations are linked in strength; there is no need to restore guard posts and garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison towns of Chongming and Langshan stand opposite each other at the river mouth, and the coastal patrol stations are linked in strength, so there is no need to reestablish the old guard posts and garrisons.

sentences.zh: 瀕海砲台，應改建者一，華亭漴缺墩；

translations.literal: Among coastal batteries, one should be rebuilt: the Chongque Battery at Huating;
translations.idiomatic: Of the coastal batteries, one should be rebuilt: the Chongque Battery at Huating;

sentences.zh: 應增建者二：柘林南門，福山挑山嘴；

translations.literal: two should be newly built: the south gate of Zhelin, and Tiaoshanzui at Fushan;
translations.idiomatic: two should be newly constructed: the south gate of Zhelin and Tiaoshanzui at Fushan;

sentences.zh: 應移建者一，吳淞王家嘴；

translations.literal: one should be relocated and rebuilt: Wangjiazui at Wusong;
translations.idiomatic: one should be relocated and rebuilt: Wangjiazui at Wusong;

sentences.zh: 應修者一，劉河北七丫口。

translations.literal: one should be repaired: Qiyakou north of Liuhe."
translations.idiomatic: one should be repaired: Qiyakou north of Liuhe."

sentences.zh: 」並請改舊制，撤牆設垛，置木蓋，留貯藥之屋；

translations.literal: He also requested that the old system be changed: walls removed and battlements set up, wooden covers installed, and rooms kept for storing gunpowder;
translations.idiomatic: He also requested reforms to the old system: remove the walls and install battlements, add wooden covers, and reserve rooms for storing gunpowder;

sentences.zh: 並請城茜涇，設兵崇明西南二條監河、顧四房溝、堂沙頭港諸地。

translations.literal: and that Qianjing be fortified, with troops posted at Ertiao Jianhe, Gusi Fang'gou, and Tangshatougang in southwestern Chongming.
translations.idiomatic: He further requested that Qianjing be fortified and troops stationed at Ertiao Jianhe, Gusi Fang'gou, and Tangshatougang in southwestern Chongming.

sentences.zh: 下部議行。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent to the ministry for deliberation and enactment.
translations.idiomatic: The Board deliberated on the proposal and approved its implementation.

sentences.zh: 江南旱，上命撥福建倉穀三十萬石治賑。

translations.literal: Jiangnan suffered drought; the emperor ordered three hundred thousand shi of grain from Fujian granaries to be allocated for relief.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangnan suffered drought, the emperor ordered three hundred thousand shi of grain from Fujian granaries to be allocated for relief.

sentences.zh: 那蘇圖奏言：「江、廣諸省買米，次第運至，無災州縣，本年漕糧全數截留，兩江不患無米。

translations.literal: Na Sutu memorialized: "The rice purchased by Jiangsu, Guangdong, and other provinces is arriving in succession. In counties and prefectures without disaster, this year's grain tribute is being fully retained, so the Two Jiangs need not fear a shortage of rice.
translations.idiomatic: Na Sutu memorialized: "Rice purchased by Jiangsu, Guangdong, and other provinces is arriving in succession. In counties and prefectures that have not suffered disaster, this year's grain tribute is being fully retained on site, so the Two Jiangs need not fear a shortage of rice.

sentences.zh: 福建海疆重地，且不產米，請留十萬石分撥災區，以二十萬石運還福建。

translations.literal: Fujian is a vital coastal frontier and does not produce rice. I request that one hundred thousand shi be kept and distributed to disaster areas, and two hundred thousand shi be transported back to Fujian."
translations.idiomatic: Fujian is a vital coastal frontier and does not produce rice. I request that one hundred thousand shi be retained and distributed to the disaster areas, and two hundred thousand shi be transported back to Fujian."

sentences.zh: 」上嘉其得封疆大臣之度。

translations.literal: The emperor praised him for showing the judgment of a frontier grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him for displaying the judgment befitting a frontier grand minister.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔免兩江地丁錢糧。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict exempted land tax and grain tribute in the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, an edict exempted land tax and grain tribute throughout the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「向例蠲免不分貧富，但富戶遇歉，未傷元氣；

translations.literal: He memorialized: "By past practice, exemptions made no distinction between rich and poor, yet when wealthy households encounter famine, their resources are not seriously depleted;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "By past practice, tax exemptions made no distinction between rich and poor, yet when wealthy households encounter famine, their resources are not seriously depleted;

sentences.zh: 貧民素乏蓋藏，多免一分，即受一分之惠。

translations.literal: the poor ordinarily lack reserves; for each additional portion exempted, they receive a corresponding measure of relief.
translations.idiomatic: the poor ordinarily lack reserves, and for each additional portion exempted, they receive a corresponding measure of relief.

sentences.zh: 請以各州縣實徵冊為據，額根五錢以下者全蠲，五錢以上者酌量蠲免，五兩以上者無庸議蠲。

translations.literal: I request that the actual collection registers of each prefecture and county be used as the basis: amounts of five qian or below should be fully exempted; amounts above five qian should be partially exempted at discretion; amounts above five taels need not be considered for exemption."
translations.idiomatic: I request that the actual collection registers of each prefecture and county serve as the basis: amounts of five qian or below should be fully exempted; amounts above five qian should be partially exempted at discretion; and amounts above five taels need not be considered for exemption."

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「卿能如此酌議，如此擔當，誠為可嘉。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "You have deliberated and taken responsibility in this way—truly commendable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "You have deliberated and taken responsibility in this way—truly commendable.

sentences.zh: 古人云'有治人無治法'，當訪察胥役，毋令因事擾民，則全美矣。

translations.literal: The ancients said, 'There are people to govern, but no laws to govern with.' You should investigate the clerks and runners and not let them use this as a pretext to harass the people—then all will be perfect."
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said, 'There are people to govern, but no laws to govern with.' You should investigate the clerks and runners and not let them use this as a pretext to harass the people—then the policy will be fully realized."

sentences.zh: 」以憂去。

translations.literal: He left office due to mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 五年，授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he was appointed minister of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, he was appointed minister of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 旋出署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Soon after he went out to serve as acting governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was dispatched to serve as acting governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 六年，調兩江。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was transferred to the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, he was transferred to the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 七年，調閩浙。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he was transferred to Min-Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, he was transferred to Min-Zhe.

sentences.zh: 疏裁闔省鹽場浮費，場員受年節規禮，以不枉法贓論罪。

translations.literal: In a memorial he cut superfluous expenses at salt fields throughout the province; salt-field officials who accepted seasonal gifts were punished under the statute on accepting bribes without perverting the law.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he eliminated superfluous expenses at salt fields throughout the province; salt-field officials who accepted seasonal gifts were punished under the statute on accepting bribes without perverting the law.

sentences.zh: 八年，疏言：「溫、台二洋，漁船汛兵，向有陋規。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he memorialized: "In the waters off Wenzhou and Taizhou, patrol soldiers for fishing boats had corrupt practices.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, he memorialized: "In the waters off Wenzhou and Taizhou, patrol soldiers for fishing boats had long-standing corrupt practices.

sentences.zh: 總督李衛奏改塗稅，稽曾筠又請減半徵收。

translations.literal: Governor-General Li Wei memorialized to change it to a landing tax, and Ji Zengyun further requested that collection be halved.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Li Wei memorialized to replace it with a landing tax, and Ji Zengyun further requested that collection be halved.

sentences.zh: 漁船出洋，海關徵樑頭稅，有司徵漁課，不當復加塗稅。

translations.literal: When fishing boats put out to sea, the customs office collects beam-head tax and local officials collect fishing dues; a landing tax should not be added on top.
translations.idiomatic: When fishing boats put out to sea, the customs office collects beam-head tax and local officials collect fishing dues; a landing tax should not be added on top.

sentences.zh: 」命永遠革除。

translations.literal: An order permanently abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: An order permanently abolished the practice.

sentences.zh: 九年，疏言：「台灣孤懸海外，漳、泉、潮、惠流民聚居，巡台御史熊學鵬議令開荒。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he memorialized: "Taiwan stands alone beyond the sea, with migrants from Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, Chaozhou, and Huizhou living together in concentration. The Taiwan touring censor Xiong Xuepeng proposed opening wilderness for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, he memorialized: "Taiwan stands alone beyond the sea, with migrants from Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, Chaozhou, and Huizhou living together in concentration. The Taiwan touring censor Xiong Xuepeng proposed opening wilderness for cultivation.

sentences.zh: 臣思曠土久封，遽行召墾，恐匪徒滋事，已令中止。

translations.literal: I considered that long-sealed vacant land, if suddenly opened for reclamation, might stir up troublemakers, and have already ordered a halt.
translations.idiomatic: I considered that long-sealed vacant land, if suddenly opened for reclamation, might stir up troublemakers, and have already ordered a halt.

sentences.zh: 」報聞。

translations.literal: The report was noted.
translations.idiomatic: The report was noted.

sentences.zh: 旋調兩廣。

translations.literal: Soon after he was transferred to the Two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was transferred to the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 十年，條奏：「兩廣鹽政，請以商欠鹽價羨餘分年帶徵。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he submitted detailed memorials: "For the salt administration of the Two Guangs, I request that surplus from merchants' unpaid salt prices be collected over successive years.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, he submitted detailed memorials: "For the salt administration of the Two Guangs, I request that surplus from merchants' unpaid salt prices be collected over successive years.

sentences.zh: 商已承替，令承替者償；

translations.literal: If a merchant has been replaced, let the replacement pay;
translations.idiomatic: If a merchant has been replaced, let the replacement pay;

sentences.zh: 官或侵漁，令侵漁者償。

translations.literal: if officials embezzled, let the embezzlers pay.
translations.idiomatic: if officials embezzled, let the embezzlers pay.

sentences.zh: 埠商佔引地，逋成本，斥逐另募。

translations.literal: Wharf merchants who occupied salt distribution sites and defaulted on capital should be expelled and replacements recruited.
translations.idiomatic: Wharf merchants who occupied salt distribution sites and defaulted on capital should be expelled and replacements recruited.

sentences.zh: 鹽課外加二五加一，並屬私派，悉行禁革。

translations.literal: The extra levies of 'two-five' and 'add-one' on top of salt duties were all unauthorized surcharges and were entirely prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: The extra levies of 'two-five' and 'add-one' on top of salt duties were all unauthorized surcharges and were entirely prohibited.

sentences.zh: 」又調直隸。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to Zhili.

sentences.zh: 十一年，條奏八旗屯田章程。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he submitted detailed memorials on regulations for Eight Banner garrison fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, he submitted detailed memorials on regulations for Eight Banner garrison fields.

sentences.zh: 十二年，上東巡，那蘇圖從至通州，賚白金萬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, when the emperor toured east, Na Sutu accompanied him to Tongzhou and was granted ten thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, when the emperor toured east, Na Sutu accompanied him to Tongzhou and was granted ten thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 條奏稽察山海關諸事，並如所奏議行。

translations.literal: He submitted detailed memorials on inspecting affairs at Shanhaiguan, and all were deliberated upon and enacted as memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted detailed memorials on inspecting affairs at Shanhaiguan, and all were deliberated upon and enacted as he proposed.

sentences.zh: 加太子少傅。

translations.literal: He was given the additional title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the additional title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十三年，加太子太保，授領侍衛內大臣，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, he was given the additional title of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, appointed chief commandant of the guard, and retained his governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, he was given the additional title of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, appointed chief commandant of the guard, and retained his governorship.

sentences.zh: 那蘇圖請赴金川軍前佐班第治事，上不許。

translations.literal: Na Sutu requested to go to the Jinchuan front to assist Ban Di in managing affairs; the emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Na Sutu requested to go to the Jinchuan front to assist Ban Di in managing affairs; the emperor did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 十四年，命暫署河道總督。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, he was ordered to serve temporarily as canal governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, he was ordered to serve temporarily as canal governor.

sentences.zh: 卒，賜祭葬，諡恪勤。

translations.literal: He died and was granted sacrificial rites and burial honors; his posthumous title was Keqin.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was granted sacrificial rites and burial honors; his posthumous title was Keqin.

sentences.zh: =楊超曾=楊超曾，字孟班，湖南武陵人。

translations.literal: Yang Chaoceng, style Mengban, a native of Wuling in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Chaoceng, courtesy name Mengban, was a native of Wuling in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十四年進士，改庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the fifty-fourth year of Kangxi, he became a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi in the fifty-fourth year of the Kangxi reign, he became a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy and was appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，直南書房。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, he served in the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Yongzheng reign, he served in the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 時湖南北甫分闈，命充湖北鄉試考官。

translations.literal: At that time Hunan and Hubei had just been given separate examination halls; he was ordered to serve as examiner for the Hubei provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hunan and Hubei had just been given separate examination halls; he was ordered to serve as examiner for the Hubei provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 旋督陝西學政。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed educational commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was appointed educational commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 再遷左庶子。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to left subreader.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to left subreader.

sentences.zh: 六年，疏陳：「鎮安、山陽、商南、平利、紫陽、石泉、白河諸縣士風衰落，西安、漢中各屬冒考，號為寄籍，諸弊叢生。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he memorialized: "In the counties of Zhen'an, Shanyang, Shangnan, Pingli, Ziyang, Shiquan, and Baihe, scholarly standards have declined. In the jurisdictions of Xi'an and Hanzhong, candidates fraudulently sit for examinations under attached registration, and abuses multiply.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, he memorialized: "In the counties of Zhen'an, Shanyang, Shangnan, Pingli, Ziyang, Shiquan, and Baihe, scholarly standards have declined. In the jurisdictions of Xi'an and Hanzhong, candidates fraudulently sit for examinations under attached registration, and abuses multiply.

sentences.zh: 請就本籍量取，寧缺無濫。

translations.literal: I request that quotas be filled from native registration only, preferring vacancies to lax standards.
translations.idiomatic: I request that quotas be filled from native registration only, preferring vacancies to lax standards.

sentences.zh: 並改寄籍者歸本籍，廩增俱作附生。

translations.literal: Those with attached registration should be returned to their native registration, and all stipendiary and augmented students should be made supplementary students.
translations.idiomatic: Those with attached registration should be returned to their native registration, and all stipendiary and augmented students should be made supplementary students.

sentences.zh: 」議行。

translations.literal: The proposal was deliberated upon and enacted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was deliberated upon and enacted.

sentences.zh: 調順天學政。

translations.literal: He was transferred as educational commissioner of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as educational commissioner of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 遷侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He was promoted to reader of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to reader of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 九年，擢奉天府尹。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was elevated to prefect of Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, he was promoted to prefect of Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「奉天各屬科派多於正供，造冊有費，考試有費，修廨宇、治保甲有費。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In the jurisdictions of Fengtian, unauthorized levies exceed regular tribute. There are fees for compiling registers, fees for examinations, fees for repairing offices, and fees for managing community defense.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "In the jurisdictions of Fengtian, unauthorized levies exceed regular tribute. There are fees for compiling registers, fees for examinations, fees for repairing offices, and fees for managing community defense.

sentences.zh: 長官取之州縣，州縣取之民間，衙蠹裡胥，指一派十，嬰害尤劇。

translations.literal: Superior officials take from prefectures and counties, prefectures and counties take from the people, and yamen parasites and village runners multiply one levy into ten—the harm is especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Superior officials take from prefectures and counties, prefectures and counties take from the people, and yamen parasites and village runners multiply one levy into ten—the harm is especially severe.

sentences.zh: 已嚴檄所屬檄鑱石禁。

translations.literal: I have already issued strict orders to subordinates forbidding the carving of such levies on stone.
translations.idiomatic: I have already issued strict orders to subordinates forbidding the carving of such levies on stone.

sentences.zh: 」上韙之，下其奏永為例。

translations.literal: The emperor approved it and issued his memorial as a permanent precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved it and issued his memorial as a permanent precedent.

sentences.zh: 十年，疏言：「秋收稍歉，明春米穀勢必騰貴，請停商運。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he memorialized: "The autumn harvest was somewhat poor; next spring grain prices will surely rise. I request that merchant transport be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, he memorialized: "The autumn harvest was somewhat poor; next spring grain prices will surely rise. I request that merchant transport be suspended.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent to the ministry for deliberation and enactment.
translations.idiomatic: The Board deliberated on the proposal and approved its implementation.

sentences.zh: 十一年，疏言：「州縣所收加一耗羨，自錦州、寧遠外，俱留充州縣養廉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he memorialized: "The 'add-one' surcharge surplus collected by prefectures and counties, except at Jinzhou and Ningyuan, should all be retained to fund their integrity allowances.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, he memorialized: "The 'add-one' surcharge surplus collected by prefectures and counties, except at Jinzhou and Ningyuan, should all be retained to fund their integrity allowances.

sentences.zh: 府尹以下養廉，以中江等稅羨支給。

translations.literal: Integrity allowances for the prefect and those below should be paid from surpluses such as the Zhongjiang tax.
translations.idiomatic: Integrity allowances for the prefect and those below should be paid from surpluses such as the Zhongjiang tax.

sentences.zh: 」部議即以是年始，著為令。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and ordered that this begin that year and be established as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The Board deliberated and ordered that this begin that year and be established as a regulation.

sentences.zh: 內務府準御史八十條奏，增錦州莊頭百戶撥民種退圈地畝。

translations.literal: The Imperial Household Department, following a memorial of eighty articles by the censor, proposed adding one hundred estate managers at Jinzhou and allocating to them reclaimed garrison land that commoners had been cultivating.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Household Department, following a memorial of eighty articles by the censor, proposed adding one hundred estate managers at Jinzhou and allocating to them reclaimed garrison land that commoners had been cultivating.

sentences.zh: 超曾奏：「地給民種，立業已久。

translations.literal: Chaoceng memorialized: "The land was given to commoners to cultivate, and they have established livelihoods there for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: Chaoceng memorialized: "The land was given to commoners to cultivate, and they have established livelihoods there for a long time.

sentences.zh: 今增莊頭百戶，戶給六百五十晌，晌六畝，都計三十九萬畝。

translations.literal: Now one hundred estate managers are to be added, each given six hundred fifty shang, with six mu per shang, totaling three hundred ninety thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: Now one hundred estate managers are to be added, each given six hundred fifty shang, with six mu per shang, totaling three hundred ninety thousand mu.

sentences.zh: 民間萬戶，無地可耕，一時斷難安輯。

translations.literal: Ten thousand commoner households would have no land to cultivate, and it would be impossible to settle them all at once.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand commoner households would have no land to cultivate, and it would be impossible to settle them all at once.

sentences.zh: 且正值春耕，清丈動需時日，舊戶新莊俱不能播種，本年賦必兩懸。

translations.literal: Moreover, it is spring planting season; a survey would take time, and neither old households nor new estates could sow—this year's taxes would be left uncollected on both sides.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, it is spring planting season; a survey would take time, and neither old households nor new estates could sow—this year's taxes would be left uncollected on both sides.

sentences.zh: 請緩俟秋收查丈。

translations.literal: I request that it be deferred until after the autumn harvest for survey and measurement.
translations.idiomatic: I request that it be deferred until after the autumn harvest for survey and measurement.

sentences.zh: 」事遂寢。

translations.literal: The matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was then dropped.

sentences.zh: 遷倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice minister of the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice minister of the granaries.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢刑部額外侍郎，仍督倉場如故。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he was elevated to extra vice minister of the Board of Punishments while continuing to oversee the granaries as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, he was promoted to extra vice minister of the Board of Punishments while continuing to oversee the granaries as before.

sentences.zh: 旋授刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed vice minister of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was appointed vice minister of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，署廣西巡撫，二年，實授。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, he served as acting governor of Guangxi; in the second year, he received the regular appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign, he served as acting governor of Guangxi; in the second year, he received the regular appointment.

sentences.zh: 疏請豁除桂林等府縣各墟及賀縣花麻地租雜稅。

translations.literal: In a memorial he requested exemption of miscellaneous taxes on market stalls in Guilin and other prefectures and counties, and on hemp-field rents in Hexian.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he requested exemption of miscellaneous taxes on market stalls in Guilin and other prefectures and counties, and on hemp-field rents in Hexian.

sentences.zh: 初，巡撫金鉷奏令廢員官生墾荒報捐，有司因以為利，搜民間有餘熟田，量給工本，即作新墾。

translations.literal: Earlier, Governor Jin Qiong memorialized to allow dismissed officials and student scions to reclaim wilderness and report contributions; local officials treated this as profit, searched out surplus cultivated land among the people, supplied seed capital in measured amounts, and reported it as new reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Governor Jin Qiong memorialized to allow dismissed officials and student scions to reclaim wilderness and report contributions; local officials treated this as profit, searched out surplus cultivated land among the people, supplied seed capital in measured amounts, and reported it as new reclamation.

sentences.zh: 雲南布政使陳宏謀疏陳其弊，下總督鄂彌達及超曾覈覆。

translations.literal: Yunnan financial commissioner Chen Hongmou memorialized on its abuses; the order was sent down to Governor-General E Mida and Chaoceng for verification.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan financial commissioner Chen Hongmou memorialized on its abuses; the order was sent down to Governor-General E Mida and Chaoceng for verification.

sentences.zh: 會疏陳捐墾不實田畝、應減應豁及官生短給工本諸事，上命豁加賦虛田凡數万畝，鉷及布政使張鉞皆奪官。

translations.literal: They jointly memorialized on fictitious contributed reclamation, acreage that should be reduced or exempted, and shortchanging of seed capital to student scions. The emperor ordered exemption of tens of thousands of mu of falsely assessed land, and both Qiong and financial commissioner Zhang Yue were dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: They jointly memorialized on fictitious contributed reclamation, acreage that should be reduced or exempted, and shortchanging of seed capital to student scions. The emperor ordered exemption of tens of thousands of mu of falsely assessed land, and both Qiong and financial commissioner Zhang Yue were dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 三年，召授兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was summoned and appointed minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, he was summoned and appointed minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 五年夏，署兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fifth year, he served as acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fifth year, he served as acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 秋，授吏部尚書，仍署總督。

translations.literal: In autumn, he was appointed minister of the Board of Civil Appointments while still serving as acting governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, he was appointed minister of the Board of Civil Appointments while still serving as acting governor-general.

sentences.zh: 疏劾江西巡撫岳濬及知府董文偉、劉永錫徇情納賄，遣侍郎阿里袞會江南河道總督高斌按治，濬等坐譴。

translations.literal: In a memorial he impeached Jiangxi Governor Yue Jun and prefects Dong Wenwei and Liu Yongxi for favoritism and accepting bribes; Vice Minister A Ligun was dispatched together with Jiangnan canal governor Gao Bin to investigate, and Jun and the others were punished.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he impeached Jiangxi Governor Yue Jun and prefects Dong Wenwei and Liu Yongxi for favoritism and accepting bribes; Vice Minister A Ligun was dispatched together with Jiangnan canal governor Gao Bin to investigate, and Jun and the others were punished.

sentences.zh: 六年，疏請裁太通道、揚州鹽務道，以通州隸常鎮道轄，餘如舊，可其奏。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he memorialized to abolish the Taotong Circuit and the Yangzhou Salt Administration Circuit, placing Tongzhou under the jurisdiction of the Chang-Zhen Circuit with the rest unchanged; his memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, he memorialized to abolish the Taotong Circuit and the Yangzhou Salt Administration Circuit, placing Tongzhou under the jurisdiction of the Chang-Zhen Circuit with the rest unchanged; his memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 兼署安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: He also served as acting governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: He also served as acting governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 秋，大風雨，濱江、海諸州縣皆被水。

translations.literal: In autumn, great wind and rain flooded all river and coastal prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, great wind and rain flooded all river and coastal prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 超曾令先以本州縣所存銀米撫卹，並發司庫銀八萬、未被水諸州縣倉米十萬，賑上江各州縣；

translations.literal: Chaoceng ordered that relief first be dispensed from silver and grain stored locally in each prefecture and county, and that eighty thousand taels from the provincial treasury and one hundred thousand shi of grain from granaries in undamaged prefectures and counties be distributed to relieve the upstream prefectures and counties;
translations.idiomatic: Chaoceng ordered that relief first be dispensed from silver and grain stored locally in each prefecture and county, and that eighty thousand taels from the provincial treasury and one hundred thousand shi of grain from granaries in undamaged prefectures and counties be distributed to relieve the upstream prefectures and counties;

sentences.zh: 又發司庫銀十萬、各縣穀百餘萬，賑下江各州縣。

translations.literal: Again issued one hundred thousand taels from the provincial treasury and over one million shi of grain from the counties to relieve the lower Yangtze prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: He also disbursed one hundred thousand taels from the provincial treasury and more than one million shi of grain from the counties to provide relief in the lower Yangtze prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 疏入，上諭曰：「料理賑恤，頗為得宜。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, the emperor instructed: "The handling of relief is quite appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor said: "Your handling of relief and succor is quite well judged.

sentences.zh: 當以至誠惻怛為之，庶可稍救災黎也。

translations.literal: One ought to do it with utmost sincerity and compassion, so that the disaster victims may be somewhat saved.
translations.idiomatic: It should be done with the utmost sincerity and heartfelt compassion, so that the afflicted people may be given some measure of relief.

sentences.zh: 」通州鹽河亦以水發輟工，督治水利大理寺卿汪漋、副都御史德爾敏令開唐家閘洩水。

translations.literal: " At Tongzhou the salt canal also halted work because of flooding; Minister of the Court of Judicature and Review Wang Yong and Censor-in-chief Der Min, who were supervising water conservancy, ordered the Tangjia Sluice opened to release water.
translations.idiomatic: " At Tongzhou the salt canal project also stopped because of the flood. Wang Yong, minister of the Court of Judicature and Review, and Der Min, censor-in-chief, who were overseeing waterworks, ordered the Tangjia Sluice opened to discharge water.

sentences.zh: 民慮淹及麥田，紛集欲罷巿。

translations.literal: The people feared inundation of their wheat fields and gathered in crowds wanting to halt the work.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing that their wheat fields would be flooded, the people gathered in large numbers and demanded that the operation be stopped.

sentences.zh: 侍郎楊嗣璟疏劾，命超曾按其事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Yang Sijing memorialized to impeach; Chaoceng was ordered to investigate the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Yang Sijing submitted an impeachment memorial, and Chaoceng was ordered to look into the affair.

sentences.zh: 超曾奏：「民無挾制阻撓情狀，似可無事深究。

translations.literal: Chaoceng memorialized: "The people show no signs of coercive obstruction; it seems no deep investigation is needed.
translations.idiomatic: Chaoceng reported: "There is no evidence that the people were coercively obstructing the work; it seems unnecessary to pursue the matter further.

sentences.zh: 」上從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 复疏薦江蘇巡撫徐士林處己儉約，安徽巡撫陳大受虛中無滯，江西巡撫包括性情和平，惟吏玩民刁，鮮所整頓。

translations.literal: He again memorialized recommending Jiangsu Governor Xu Shilin for frugal self-discipline, Anhui Governor Chen Dashou for openness without rigidity, and Jiangxi Governor Bao Huo for a peaceful temperament; only the clerks were slack and the people crafty, with little rectification.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted another memorial praising Jiangsu Governor Xu Shilin for his thrift and restraint, Anhui Governor Chen Dashou for his open-mindedness and freedom from rigidity, and Jiangxi Governor Bao Huo for his even temper, while noting that only in Jiangxi were officials lax and the people troublesome, with little being done to set matters right.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「此至當至公之論，與朕見同也。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "This is thoroughly proper and fair discourse, matching my own view.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "These are entirely fair and judicious remarks, and they accord with my own view.

sentences.zh: 」尋內召視部事，以父憂歸，籍喪次。

translations.literal: " Soon after he was summoned to the capital to attend to ministry affairs, returned because of his father's mourning, and registered at the mourning residence.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon afterward he was called to the capital to handle affairs at the ministry, but returned home upon his father's death and took up residence during the mourning period.

sentences.zh: 病作，七年，卒，賜祭葬，諡文敏。

translations.literal: Illness arose; in the seventh year he died, was granted sacrificial rites and burial honors, and received the posthumous title Wenmin.
translations.idiomatic: He fell ill and, in the seventh year, died. He was granted state sacrifices and burial honors, and his posthumous title was Wenmin.

sentences.zh: =徐士林=徐士林，字式儒，山東文登人。

translations.literal: Xu Shilin, style Shiru, a native of Wendeng in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shilin, courtesy name Shiru, was a native of Wendeng in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 父農也，士林幼聞鄰塾讀書聲，慕之，跪母前曰：「原送兒入塾。

translations.literal: His father was a farmer; as a child Shilin heard reading from a neighboring school, admired it, knelt before his mother and said: "I wish to be sent to school.
translations.idiomatic: His father was a farmer. As a boy, Shilin heard the sound of reading from a neighboring school and longed to join them. Kneeling before his mother, he said: "Please send me to school.

sentences.zh: 」乃奮志勵學。

translations.literal: " Then he resolved his will and applied himself to study.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereafter he set his mind on study and pursued it with determination.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十二年，成進士，授內閣中書。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year of Kangxi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed a Secretariat drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year of the Kangxi reign he became a jinshi and was appointed a Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 再遷禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was subsequently promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，授江南安慶知府。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng he was appointed prefect of Anqing in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign he was appointed prefect of Anqing in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢江蘇按察使。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to judicial commissioner of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was promoted to judicial commissioner of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 坐在安慶失察私鑄，左遷福建汀漳道。

translations.literal: He was punished for failing while at Anqing to detect private coining and was demoted to intendant of Tingzhang Circuit in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He was held accountable for failing to detect private coining while serving at Anqing and was demoted to intendant of Tingzhang Circuit in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 漳州俗好鬥，殺人，捕之，輒聚眾據山拒。

translations.literal: Zhangzhou custom favored fighting; when killers were arrested, they would gather crowds and hold the mountains to resist.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Zhangzhou were prone to violence. Whenever a killer was arrested, his followers would gather and seize the hills to resist capture.

sentences.zh: 或請用兵，士林不可。

translations.literal: Some requested the use of troops; Shilin would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Some suggested sending troops, but Shilin refused.

sentences.zh: 命壯丁分扼要隘，三日，度其食且盡，遣人深入，好語曰：「垂手出山者免！

translations.literal: He ordered strong men to block the key passes in separate groups; after three days, estimating that their food was nearly exhausted, he sent men deep inside with kind words, saying: "Those who come out empty-handed will be spared!
translations.idiomatic: He posted able-bodied men at the strategic passes. After three days, judging that the fugitives' provisions were nearly gone, he sent men inside with reassuring words: "Whoever comes down the mountain unarmed will go free!

sentences.zh: 」如其言，果逐隊出。

translations.literal: " As he had said, they indeed came out in groups one after another.
translations.idiomatic: " As he had promised, they came down in groups, one band after another.

sentences.zh: 伏其仇於旁，仇舉為首者，擒以徇，眾驚散。

translations.literal: He hid their enemies nearby; an enemy pointed out the ringleader, who was seized and paraded as a warning, and the crowd scattered in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: He had their enemies hidden nearby. One enemy identified the ringleader, who was seized and executed as a public warning, whereupon the rest fled in terror.

sentences.zh: 自此捕殺人者，無敢據山拒。

translations.literal: From then on, when killers were arrested, none dared hold the mountains to resist.
translations.idiomatic: After that, whenever killers were pursued, none dared again to hold the hills in defiance.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，遷河南布政使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was transferred to financial commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign he was transferred to financial commissioner of Henan.

sentences.zh: 以父病乞歸侍，旋居父喪。

translations.literal: He requested leave to return and attend his ill father, and soon entered mourning for his father.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to return home to care for his ailing father and soon afterward entered mourning upon his father's death.

sentences.zh: 命署江蘇布政使，士林以母病、父未葬，辭。

translations.literal: He was ordered to serve as acting financial commissioner of Jiangsu; Shilin declined, citing his mother's illness and his father's unburied state.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to serve as acting financial commissioner of Jiangsu, but Shilin declined on the grounds that his mother was ill and his father had not yet been buried.

sentences.zh: 四年，命以布政使護江蘇巡撫，復奏母病篤不能行。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was ordered, as financial commissioner, to oversee the Jiangsu governorship; he again memorialized that his mother was gravely ill and he could not travel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was ordered to serve as financial commissioner while overseeing the Jiangsu governorship, but he again reported that his mother was critically ill and that he could not leave home.

sentences.zh: 是年夏，詣京師，高宗召對，問：「道所經山東、直隸，麥收若何？

translations.literal: That summer he went to the capital; the Gaozong Emperor summoned him for audience and asked: "Along the route through Shandong and Zhili, how is the wheat harvest?
translations.idiomatic: That summer he went to the capital, where the Gaozong Emperor received him in audience and asked: "Along the road through Shandong and Zhili, how did the wheat crop fare?

sentences.zh: 」曰：「旱且萎。

translations.literal: " He replied: "There was drought and withering.
translations.idiomatic: " He answered: "There was drought, and the crop withered.

sentences.zh: 」問：「得雨如何？

translations.literal: " The emperor asked: "If rain falls, what then?
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor asked: "If rain comes, will that help?

sentences.zh: 」曰：「雖雨無益。

translations.literal: " He replied: "Even with rain there would be no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: " He replied: "Even rain would do no good.

sentences.zh: 」問：「何以用人？

translations.literal: " The emperor asked: "How should one employ men?
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor asked: "How should one choose and use officials?

sentences.zh: 」曰：「工獻納者，雖敏非才；

translations.literal: " He replied: "Those skilled at tribute and presentation, though clever, are not truly talented;
translations.idiomatic: " He answered: "Men who are adept at flattery and gift-giving may be quick-witted, but they lack real ability;

sentences.zh: 昧是非者，雖廉實蠹。

translations.literal: those who fail to distinguish right from wrong, though incorrupt, are in truth pests.
translations.idiomatic: while those who cannot tell right from wrong, though seemingly honest, are in fact a plague upon government.

sentences.zh: 」上深然之。

translations.literal: " The emperor deeply agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor was deeply impressed and agreed.

sentences.zh: 真除江蘇布政使。

translations.literal: He was formally appointed financial commissioner of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was then formally appointed financial commissioner of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 五年，湖廣遣山東流民還裡，道經江南，恃其眾擾民。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Huguang sent Shandong refugees back to their native places; passing through Jiangnan, they relied on their numbers to harass the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Huguang began sending Shandong refugees home. As they passed through Jiangnan, they took advantage of their numbers to harass the local population.

sentences.zh: 士林疏言：「真確災民，或有田可耕，或無田而佃，素皆力穡。

translations.literal: Shilin memorialized: "Genuine disaster victims, some with land to farm and some without land but tenant-farming, have all ordinarily tilled diligently.
translations.idiomatic: Shilin memorialized: "Those who are truly disaster victims, whether they own land to cultivate or rent fields as tenants, have always been hardworking farmers.

sentences.zh: 時值春融，自當資送復業。

translations.literal: Now that spring thaw has come, they should naturally be assisted and sent home to resume their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: Now that spring has arrived, they should naturally be given assistance and sent home to resume farming.

sentences.zh: 至若遊惰無業，漂泊日久，彼固非能耕之人，亦不盡被災之民，應請停資送。

translations.literal: As for idle vagrants without occupation who have drifted for a long time, they are not people who can farm, nor are they all disaster victims; I request that assistance for their return be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: As for idle drifters without work who have wandered for a long time, they are neither capable farmers nor necessarily true disaster victims. Assistance for their return should be discontinued.

sentences.zh: 或謂無籍窮民，恐流而為匪，終年搜查遞送不得休。

translations.literal: Some say that rootless poor people may drift into banditry, so search and escort must go on without rest throughout the year.
translations.idiomatic: Some argue that homeless poor may turn to banditry, and that officials must therefore search for and escort them without cease all year long.

sentences.zh: 臣未聞不為匪於本籍，獨為匪於鄰封者；

translations.literal: Your subject has never heard of one who was not a bandit in his native place yet became a bandit only in a neighboring jurisdiction;
translations.idiomatic: I have never heard of men who refrained from banditry in their home district only to become bandits in a neighboring one;

sentences.zh: 亦未聞真為匪者遞回本籍，即能務本力田而不復潛至鄰封者也。

translations.literal: nor has your subject heard that genuine bandits, once escorted back to their native places, would then devote themselves to farming and no longer secretly come to neighboring jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: nor have I heard that real bandits, once sent back to their native places, would settle down to honest farming and never again slip into neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 安分則撫之，犯法則懲之，在地方官處置得宜而已。

translations.literal: If they keep to their place then comfort them; if they violate the law then punish them—it depends only on local officials handling matters properly.
translations.idiomatic: Those who keep the peace should be treated kindly; those who break the law should be punished. That is all that is required of local officials if they handle matters properly.

sentences.zh: 」上是其言，下九卿議行。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved his words and sent the matter down to the Nine Ministers for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved his proposal and referred it to the Nine Ministers for deliberation and enactment.

sentences.zh: 秋，授江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: In autumn he was appointed governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he was appointed governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 湖北巡撫崔紀以湖廣食淮鹽，自雍正元年定值，遞年加增，為民累，疏請核減，命士林會鹽政準泰核議。

translations.literal: Hubei Governor Cui Ji, because Huguang consumed Huai salt and the fixed price set in the first year of Yongzheng had been increased year by year to the people's burden, memorialized requesting verification and reduction; Shilin was ordered to meet Salt Controller Zhuntai for joint deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei Governor Cui Ji reported that because Huguang relied on Huai salt, the price fixed in the first year of the Yongzheng reign had risen year after year and become a burden on the people. He requested a review and reduction, and Shilin was ordered to confer with Salt Controller Zhuntai on the matter.

sentences.zh: 士林奏：「鹽為民食所資，貴固累民，賤亦累商。

translations.literal: Shilin memorialized: "Salt is what the people rely on for food; if it is expensive it burdens the people, and if it is cheap it also burdens the merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Shilin reported: "Salt is a staple of the people's diet. If the price is too high, the people suffer; if it is too low, the merchants suffer.

sentences.zh: 今確核成本，每引賤價以五兩三錢餘為率，貴價以五兩七錢餘為率。

translations.literal: Now, having verified the costs precisely, the low price per salt license is set at a rate of five taels and a little over three qian, and the high price at five taels and a little over seven qian.
translations.idiomatic: After a careful review of costs, the low price per license should be set at about five taels and three qian, and the high price at about five taels and seven qian.

sentences.zh: 商人計子母，若令按本出售，恐商力日絀，轉運不前，民亦所未便。

translations.literal: Merchants calculate principal and profit; if they are made to sell at cost, I fear their capacity will daily be depleted, transport will not advance, and the people too will not be well served.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants must cover both capital and profit. If they are forced to sell at cost alone, their resources will steadily dwindle, transport will falter, and the people will suffer as well.

sentences.zh: 請每引酌給餘息二三錢。

translations.literal: I request that two or three qian of surplus interest be granted per license as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore ask that two or three qian of surplus profit be allowed on each license.

sentences.zh: 」疏下戶部議，成本如所定，至餘息已在成本內，無庸酌給。

translations.literal: " The memorial was sent to the Board of Revenue for deliberation; the costs were accepted as proposed, but since the surplus interest was already included within the costs, no additional grant was needed.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was referred to the Board of Revenue, which accepted the cost figures but ruled that surplus profit was already built into them and need not be granted separately.

sentences.zh: 士林奏：「商人牟利，運鹽不時至，巿值即因之而長。

translations.literal: Shilin memorialized: "Merchants seek profit; when salt transport does not arrive on time, market prices rise accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Shilin replied: "Merchants operate for profit. When salt deliveries are irregular, market prices rise accordingly.

sentences.zh: 鹽政三保原議每引賤至六兩三錢餘，貴至六兩五錢餘，是實有餘息。

translations.literal: Salt Controller Sanbao had originally proposed a low price per license of a little over six taels and three qian and a high price of a little over six taels and five qian; there truly was surplus interest.
translations.idiomatic: Salt Controller Sanbao had originally proposed low and high prices of about six taels and three qian and six taels and five qian per license respectively, which clearly left room for profit.

sentences.zh: 今臣所議已將餘息減除，僅加息二三錢。

translations.literal: What your subject now proposes has already deducted the surplus interest and adds only two or three qian of interest.
translations.idiomatic: The plan I now propose has already cut back that surplus and allows only two or three qian of additional profit.

sentences.zh: 計售於民，每斤增不過以毫計，利已至薄。

translations.literal: Calculated in sales to the people, the increase per jin would amount to no more than fractions of a qian; the profit is already extremely thin.
translations.idiomatic: For consumers, the increase would amount to only a fraction of a qian per jin—the margin is already very slim.

sentences.zh: 祗以商本饒裕，常年通算，積少成多。

translations.literal: It is only because merchant capital is ample that, calculated over the whole year, small amounts accumulate into large ones.
translations.idiomatic: Only because merchants have ample capital does a small profit on each sale, spread over the whole year, add up to a meaningful sum.

sentences.zh: 今不給餘息，商情必生退阻。

translations.literal: If surplus interest is not granted now, merchant sentiment will surely produce withdrawal and obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: If that surplus is denied, merchants will surely become reluctant and withdraw from the trade.

sentences.zh: 倘漢口運鹽不繼，恐淮商困而楚民亦病也。

translations.literal: If salt transport at Hankou is not continuous, I fear Huai merchants will be distressed and the people of Chu will also suffer.
translations.idiomatic: If salt shipments to Hankou falter, Huai merchants will be ruined and the people of Huguang will suffer as well.

sentences.zh: 」上特從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor specially assented.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor made a special exception and agreed.

sentences.zh: 是歲徐、海水災，士林疏請治賑。

translations.literal: That year Xuzhou and Haizhou suffered flood disasters; Shilin memorialized requesting relief and treatment.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xuzhou and Haizhou were struck by floods, and Shilin memorialized requesting relief measures.

sentences.zh: 六年春，复疏請酌借貧民穀麥。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year he again memorialized requesting appropriate loans of grain and wheat to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year he again asked that grain and wheat be lent as appropriate to the poor.

sentences.zh: 沛縣災最重，請發籓庫餘平銀糴米續賑。

translations.literal: Pei County was most severely affected; he requested that surplus treasury silver be issued to purchase rice for continued relief.
translations.idiomatic: Pei County had suffered the worst damage, and he requested surplus provincial treasury funds to buy rice for continued relief.

sentences.zh: 別疏言：「江蘇社穀積貯無多，去年秋成，惟徐、海被災，餘俱豐稔。

translations.literal: In a separate memorial he stated: "Jiangsu's community granary stores were not large; in last year's autumn harvest only Xuzhou and Haizhou were affected by disaster, while the rest were all abundant.
translations.idiomatic: In a separate memorial he wrote: "Jiangsu's community granaries held little reserve. Last autumn only Xuzhou and Haizhou were hit by disaster; everywhere else the harvest was abundant.

sentences.zh: 臣飭諸州縣勸捐十餘萬石，仍戒勿強派，勿限數，勿差役滋擾。

translations.literal: Your subject ordered the prefectures and counties to encourage donations of more than one hundred thousand shi, while still warning against forced allocation, fixed quotas, and harassment by yamen runners.
translations.idiomatic: I ordered the prefectures and counties to solicit donations of more than one hundred thousand shi, while strictly forbidding forced levies, fixed quotas, and harassment by yamen runners.

sentences.zh: 」上深嘉之。

translations.literal: " The emperor deeply praised this.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor was deeply pleased.

sentences.zh: 尋以病請告，溫旨慰留，遣醫診視。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he requested leave because of illness; a warm edict comforted and retained him, and a physician was sent to examine him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he asked for sick leave. The emperor responded with a gracious edict urging him to stay on and sent a physician to attend him.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「淮北被水，二麥無收，急宜撫卹。

translations.literal: He again memorialized: "North of the Huai has been flooded; the second crop of wheat has no harvest; relief and comfort are urgently needed.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted another memorial: "The area north of the Huai has been flooded and the wheat crop has failed. Relief must be provided at once.

sentences.zh: 臣不敢泥成例，已先飭發庫帑賑濟，俟察實成災分數具題。

translations.literal: Your subject dares not cling to precedent; he has already ordered treasury funds disbursed for relief first, awaiting verified disaster proportions before submitting a full memorial.
translations.idiomatic: I did not wait for precedent. I have already ordered treasury funds released for relief and will submit a full report once the extent of the disaster has been verified.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「如此料理，甚副朕視民如傷之念。

translations.literal: " The emperor instructed: "Such handling greatly accords with my thought of treating the people as though wounded.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Such handling fully accords with my desire to treat the people as I would treat my own injuries.

sentences.zh: 及秋，病益甚，疏請乞假，且言：「母年八十三，未能迎養，暌違兩載，寢食靡寧。

translations.literal: By autumn his illness grew worse; he memorialized requesting leave and also stated: "My mother is eighty-three; I have been unable to bring her here for care; separated for two years, my sleep and food have known no peace.
translations.idiomatic: By autumn his illness had worsened, and he asked for leave, writing: "My mother is eighty-three. I have been unable to bring her to live with me. For two years we have been apart, and I have had no peace day or night.

sentences.zh: 」上允之。

translations.literal: " The emperor granted it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor granted his request.

sentences.zh: 行至淮安，卒。

translations.literal: When he reached Huaian, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died on the road at Huaian.

sentences.zh: 遺疏入，上諭曰：「士林忠孝性成，以母老遠離，不受妻孥之養，鞠躬盡瘁，遂致沈痾。

translations.literal: When his final memorial was submitted, the emperor instructed: "Shilin's loyalty and filial piety were innate; because his mother was old and far away, he did not accept support from wife and children, bent his body utterly in service, and thus fell into grave illness.
translations.idiomatic: When his deathbed memorial arrived, the emperor said: "Shilin was loyal and filial by nature. Because his aged mother lived far away, he refused even the comfort of his wife and children, wore himself out in service, and so fell gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 及得假後，力疾旋裡，以圖侍母。

translations.literal: After obtaining leave, he strained through illness to return home, intending to serve his mother.
translations.idiomatic: After leave was granted, he forced himself homeward despite his illness in the hope of caring for his mother.

sentences.zh: 臨終無一語及私，勸朕以憂盛危明之心為長治久安之計。

translations.literal: At his death not one word touched private matters; he exhorted me with a mind anxious in prosperity and clear in peril as a plan for long peace and stability.
translations.idiomatic: At the end he spoke not a word of private concern, but urged me to guard against complacency in prosperity and to remain vigilant in peril, as the path to lasting peace.

sentences.zh: 此等良臣，方資倚任。

translations.literal: Such a good minister was just being relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: Such a worthy minister was one on whom I had only just begun to rely.

sentences.zh: 乃今溘逝，朕實切切含悲不能自已者也！

translations.literal: Yet now he has suddenly passed away; I am truly deeply grieved and cannot restrain myself!
translations.idiomatic: And now he has suddenly died. My grief is deep beyond measure!

sentences.zh: 」命祀京師賢良祠，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: " He ordered that Shilin be enshrined in the Worthies Shrine in the capital and granted sacrificial rites and burial honors.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered that Shilin be enshrined in the Worthies Shrine in the capital and granted state sacrifices and burial honors.

sentences.zh: 遺疏言：「故父之淮，母鞠氏，孝養祖父母，侍病二十餘年，歷久不懈。

translations.literal: His final memorial stated: "My late father was Zhi Huai; my mother was née Ju. She filially cared for my grandparents and attended them in illness for more than twenty years, unwearying through the long years.
translations.idiomatic: In his final memorial he wrote: "My late father was Zhi Huai and my mother was née Ju. She dutifully cared for my grandparents and nursed them through illness for more than twenty years without ever slackening.

sentences.zh: 懇賜表揚。

translations.literal: I humbly request that commendation be granted.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly ask that she be publicly commended.

sentences.zh: 」命予旌如例。

translations.literal: " He ordered that commendation be granted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered that the usual honors be conferred upon her.

sentences.zh: 士林善治獄。

translations.literal: Shilin was skilled at handling legal cases.
translations.idiomatic: Shilin was skilled at adjudicating cases.

sentences.zh: 為巡撫，守令來謁，輒具獄命擬判，每誡之曰：「深文傷和，姑息養奸。

translations.literal: As governor, when prefects and magistrates came to audience, he would always present cases and order draft judgments, each time admonishing them: "Harsh legalism harms harmony; indulgence nurtures villains.
translations.idiomatic: As governor, whenever prefects and magistrates came to see him, he would have cases brought forward and order draft judgments, always warning them: "Harsh interpretation of the law destroys harmony; excessive leniency breeds crime.

sentences.zh: 夫律例猶本草，其情事萬端，如病者之經絡虛實，不善用藥者殺人，不善用律者亦如之。

translations.literal: Statutes and precedents are like materia medica; circumstances are myriad, like a patient's meridians, emptiness, and fullness; one unskilled in using medicine kills people, and one unskilled in using the law does likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Statutes and precedents are like medicinal herbs: circumstances vary endlessly, just as a patient's condition may be hollow or full in different meridians. A physician who misuses medicine kills; an official who misuses the law does the same.

sentences.zh: 」凡讞定必先摘大略牌示，始發繕文冊，吏不得因緣為奸。

translations.literal: " Whenever a judgment was fixed, he first extracted the gist and posted it on a placard before issuing the copied documents, so that clerks could not use the opportunity for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: " Whenever a case was decided, he first posted a summary of the ruling before issuing the formal documents, so that clerks could not exploit the process for their own gain.

sentences.zh: 日治官文書，至夜坐白木榻，一燈熒然，手批目覽，雖除夕、元辰弗輟。

translations.literal: By day he handled official documents; by night he sat on a plain wooden couch with one lamp flickering, personally annotating and reviewing them, not ceasing even on New Year's Eve and New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: He handled official papers by day, and at night sat on a plain wooden couch beneath a single flickering lamp, reading and annotating documents by hand. He did not rest even on New Year's Eve or New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 愛民憂國，惟日不足。

translations.literal: He loved the people and worried for the state; the day alone was insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: His love for the people and concern for the state left him with never enough hours in the day.

sentences.zh: 江南民尤德之。

translations.literal: The people of Jiangnan especially honored him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jiangnan were especially grateful to him.

sentences.zh: 九年，請祀蘇州名宦祠。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was requested for enshrinement in the Shrine of Eminent Officials at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the people petitioned to have him enshrined in Suzhou's Shrine of Eminent Officials.

sentences.zh: 鄞縣邵基、臨汾王師與士林先後撫江蘇，有清名。

translations.literal: Shao Ji of Yin County, Wang Shi of Linfen, and Shilin successively governed Jiangsu and had reputations for integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Ji of Yin County, Wang Shi of Linfen, and Shilin served successively as governors of Jiangsu and all enjoyed reputations for clean government.

sentences.zh: 基，字學阯。

translations.literal: Ji, style Xuezhi.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Ji, courtesy name Xuezhi.

sentences.zh: 康熙六十年進士，改庶吉士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the sixtieth year of Kangxi, he became a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the sixtieth year of the Kangxi reign and became a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，授編修。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng he was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Yongzheng reign he was appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 考選福建道御史。

translations.literal: He was selected through examination as censor of the Fujian Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was selected by examination and appointed censor of the Fujian Circuit.

sentences.zh: 巡中城，止司坊官饋遺商巿月椿錢，釐積案，姦宄惕息。

translations.literal: Patrolling the central city, he stopped ward officials' gifts and the monthly squeeze money from the commercial markets, cleared accumulated cases, and villains and lawbreakers subsided in fear.
translations.idiomatic: While patrolling the central city, he put an end to ward officials' bribes and the monthly squeeze levied on merchants, cleared a backlog of cases, and lawbreakers were brought to heel.

sentences.zh: 巡直隸順德、大名、廣平三府，以廉勤飭使事。

translations.literal: He toured the three prefectures of Shuntian, Daming, and Guangping in Zhili, and with integrity and diligence regulated envoy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected Shuntian, Daming, and Guangping prefectures in Zhili, governing envoy affairs with integrity and diligence.

sentences.zh: 遷戶科給事中，命在上書房行走。

translations.literal: He was transferred to supervising secretary of the Household Section and ordered to serve in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to supervising secretary of the Household Section and assigned to serve in the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 四遷國子監祭酒，立教術五條，勉生徒以正學。

translations.literal: After four promotions he became Chancellor of the Imperial Academy, established five rules of teaching, and exhorted students toward upright learning.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted four times, he became Chancellor of the Imperial Academy, drew up five principles of instruction, and urged students to pursue proper scholarship.

sentences.zh: 歷右通政、左僉都御史，並仍兼祭酒。

translations.literal: He served successively as Right Commissioner of Transmission and Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, and in both posts still concurrently held the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Right Commissioner of Transmission and Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, retaining the chancellorship in both appointments.

sentences.zh: 十二年，遷右副都御史，擢吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was transferred to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and promoted to Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was made Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and promoted to Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「強梗屬員，以上官將予參劾，輒先發製人。

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "Obstinate subordinates, learning that a superior is about to impeach them, invariably strike first to control others.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial stating: "When obstinate subordinates learn that their superior intends to impeach them, they often strike first to destroy him.

sentences.zh: 往往參本未到，揭帖已至。

translations.literal: Often before the formal impeachment document arrives, the accusatory petition is already submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Frequently the accusatory petition reaches the court before the formal impeachment memorial itself.

sentences.zh: 質訊虛誣，按律治罪，上官已被其累。

translations.literal: When interrogation proves the charges false, the accuser is punished according to law, yet the superior has already been harmed by him.
translations.idiomatic: If investigation shows the charges to be false and the accuser is punished under the law, the superior has already been dragged down in the process.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後上官恃勢，屬員受屈，仍許直揭部科；

translations.literal: He requested that hereafter, when superiors rely on power and subordinates suffer injustice, they still be permitted to petition the ministry sections directly;
translations.idiomatic: He asked that in future, when superiors abuse their authority and subordinates are wronged, the latter still be allowed to petition the relevant ministry sections directly;

sentences.zh: 其有誣揭者，於本罪外加重科斷。

translations.literal: and that those who lodge false accusations receive additional punishment beyond their original offense.
translations.idiomatic: and that anyone who submits a false accusation receive an additional penalty beyond the punishment for the underlying offense.

sentences.zh: 」議行。

translations.literal: " The proposal was deliberated and adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved and put into effect.

sentences.zh: 尋兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was additionally appointed Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter he was also appointed Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，充博學鴻詞閱卷官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he served as examiner for the Special Examination for Erudite Scholars.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign he served as an examiner for the Special Examination for Erudite Scholars.

sentences.zh: 出為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: He went out and became Governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 二年，疏言：「江蘇各屬，江、海交錯，全資水利。

translations.literal: In the second year he memorialized, saying: "The subordinate districts of Jiangsu, where rivers and sea interweave, depend entirely on water control.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he submitted a memorial stating: "Jiangsu's subordinate districts, where rivers and sea meet, depend entirely on water management.

sentences.zh: 運道、官河及湖海鉅工，自當發帑官修。

translations.literal: Transport canals, official rivers, and major lake and sea works should naturally be funded from the treasury and repaired by the government.
translations.idiomatic: Transport routes, official rivers, and major lake and sea projects should naturally be funded from the treasury and repaired by the state.

sentences.zh: 其支河汊港，蓄水灌田，向皆民力疏濬。

translations.literal: As for branch rivers and tributary channels that store water and irrigate fields, these have always been dredged by popular labor.
translations.idiomatic: Branch rivers and side channels used to store water and irrigate fields have traditionally been dredged by local communities.

sentences.zh: 近悉請官帑，似非執中無弊。

translations.literal: Recently all have requested official funds; this seems not to be holding the mean without abuse.
translations.idiomatic: Lately every such project has been put forward for state funding, which does not seem consistent with the principle of moderation.

sentences.zh: 請將運河及江、河、湖、海專資通洩之處，仍發庫帑估修；

translations.literal: He requested that for the Grand Canal and places on rivers, lakes, and sea devoted solely to drainage and discharge, treasury funds still be issued for estimated repairs;
translations.idiomatic: He proposed that the Grand Canal and those points on rivers, lakes, and the sea devoted chiefly to drainage continue to be repaired with funds from the treasury;

sentences.zh: 其餘河港圩岸，令有司勸民以時疏濬修築，庶公私兩益。

translations.literal: for the remaining river channels and dikes, let local officials encourage the people to dredge and build in season, so that public and private interests may both benefit.
translations.idiomatic: while for other channels and dikes, local officials should encourage the people to dredge and maintain them in season, so that both state and community may benefit.

sentences.zh: 」下部議，從之。

translations.literal: " The memorial was sent to the ministry for deliberation, and the proposal was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was referred to the ministry for review, and the recommendation was adopted.

sentences.zh: 時以治賑收捐，基疏爭，略言：「天下傳皇上新政，首罷捐例。

translations.literal: At the time disaster relief was being funded through collecting donations; Ji memorialized in opposition, stating in summary: "Throughout the realm it is reported that in the Emperor's new policies the sale of offices was abolished first.
translations.idiomatic: At that time relief was being financed through soliciting donations; Shao Ji protested in a memorial, writing in brief: "The whole empire has heard that among the Emperor's new policies, the sale of offices was abolished first.

sentences.zh: 今為樂善好施之例，是開捐而巧更其名也。

translations.literal: Now establishing a precedent of charitable giving is to reopen the sale of offices while cleverly changing its name.
translations.idiomatic: To establish a precedent of charitable giving now is simply to reopen the sale of offices under a different name.

sentences.zh: 周官荒政十二，未聞乞靈於貲郎。

translations.literal: The Rites of Zhou lists twelve famine-relief measures; one never heard of seeking aid from purchasers of office.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou sets out twelve measures for famine relief; nowhere does it speak of relying on men who bought their posts.

sentences.zh: 」上命停止，戶部持不可，卒行之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered a halt, but the Board of Revenue maintained it could not be done, and in the end the policy was carried out.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor ordered it stopped, but the Board of Revenue objected that this could not be done, and in the end the policy went ahead anyway.

sentences.zh: 上以基題補按察使戴永椿，知府王喬林、石傑皆同鄉，道員李梅賓、盧見曾皆同年，不知避嫌，嚴旨詰責。

translations.literal: Because Ji had recommended for appointment Surveillance Commissioner Dai Yongchun, Prefects Wang Qiaolin and Shi Jie, all fellow townsmen, and Circuit Intendants Li Meibin and Lu Jianzeng, all examination classmates, without knowing to avoid suspicion, the Emperor issued a stern edict rebuking him.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shao Ji had recommended Surveillance Commissioner Dai Yongchun, Prefects Wang Qiaolin and Shi Jie—all men from his home district—and Circuit Intendants Li Meibin and Lu Jianzeng—all men from his examination year—without observing the rules of recusal, the Emperor issued a stern edict of rebuke.

sentences.zh: 基旋卒。

translations.literal: Ji soon afterward died.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Ji died shortly thereafter.

sentences.zh: 子鐸，官檢討，早卒。

translations.literal: His son Duo held the post of reviser and died young.
translations.idiomatic: His son Duo served as a reviser but died young.

sentences.zh: 孫洪，賜舉人，官至禮部侍郎，亦有清名。

translations.literal: His grandson Hong was granted the status of provincial graduate, rose to Vice Minister of Rites, and likewise had a reputation for integrity.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Hong was granted the status of provincial graduate, rose to Vice Minister of Rites, and likewise enjoyed a reputation for clean government.

sentences.zh: 師，字貞甫。

translations.literal: Shi, style Zhenfu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shi, courtesy name Zhenfu.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年進士，以知縣發直隸。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the eighth year of Yongzheng, he was dispatched to Zhili as a magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the eighth year of the Yongzheng reign and was sent to Zhili as a magistrate.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授元城知縣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the magistracy of Yuancheng was conferred upon him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed magistrate of Yuancheng.

sentences.zh: 王勝甿蕪田數百畝，歲有徵，請除其累。

translations.literal: Wang Sheng had several hundred mu of wasteland under cultivation, yet tax was levied every year; he requested removal of this burden.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sheng had brought several hundred mu of wasteland under cultivation, yet tax was still collected each year; Wang Shi petitioned to lift this burden.

sentences.zh: 導民樹蓺，沙壤成沃，歲祲不待請而賑。

translations.literal: He guided the people to plant mulberry and hemp; sandy soil became fertile, and in years of famine he gave relief without waiting to be asked.
translations.idiomatic: He encouraged the people to plant mulberry and hemp until sandy soil turned fertile, and in famine years he provided relief without waiting to be petitioned.

sentences.zh: 調清苑，遷冀州知州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Qingyuan and promoted to Prefect of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Qingyuan and then promoted to Prefect of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 州民被誣為殺人，已定讞，民所聘女誓同死。

translations.literal: A man of the prefecture was falsely accused of murder; the verdict was already fixed, and the woman to whom he was betrothed vowed to die with him.
translations.idiomatic: A local man had been falsely convicted of murder; the sentence was already fixed, and the woman to whom he was betrothed vowed to die with him.

sentences.zh: 廉得實，覆鞫，雪其枉，俾完娶。

translations.literal: Investigation established the truth; he reopened the case, cleared the man's wrongful conviction, and enabled him to complete his marriage.
translations.idiomatic: After an honest investigation established the facts, he reopened the case, cleared the man's name, and allowed the marriage to proceed.

sentences.zh: 累遷清河道，從大學士高斌等規畫直隸水利，週曆保定、河間、天津、正定諸地，所擘畫多被採用。

translations.literal: Promoted repeatedly, he became Commissioner of the Qinghe Circuit; following Grand Secretary Gao Bin and others in planning water control in Zhili, he toured Baoding, Hejian, Tianjin, Zhengding, and other places, and many of his proposals were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: After successive promotions he became Commissioner of the Qinghe Circuit. Working with Grand Secretary Gao Bin and others to plan water control in Zhili, he toured Baoding, Hejian, Tianjin, Zhengding, and other districts, and many of his proposals were adopted.

sentences.zh: 擢直隸按察使。

translations.literal: He was elevated to Surveillance Commissioner of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Surveillance Commissioner of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十一年，遷浙江布政使，調江蘇，巡撫安寧劾，解任。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Qianlong he was transferred to Financial Commissioner of Zhejiang, then moved to Jiangsu; Governor An Ning impeached him and he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of the Qianlong reign he was made Financial Commissioner of Zhejiang, then transferred to Jiangsu, where Governor An Ning impeached him and he was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 又以按察使任內失察邪教，降補天津道。
