translations.literal: If one wishes to replace native rule with direct administration, not only would these tiny native chieftaincies be of no benefit whatsoever, but once the seals and warrants issued them were withdrawn, they would become raw tribes without any governing authority.
translations.idiomatic: If native rule were replaced with direct administration, not only would these tiny chieftaincies be of no benefit, but once their seals and warrants were withdrawn they would become raw tribes under no authority at all.

sentences.zh: 稍有違抗，又費經營。

translations.literal: At the slightest resistance, further effort would again be required.
translations.idiomatic: At the slightest resistance, further effort would again be required.

sentences.zh: 」奏入，上以所見甚是，褒之，寢前議未行。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, the Emperor considered his views very sound, commended him, and shelved the earlier proposal, which was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial reached the throne, the Emperor judged his views very sound, praised him, and shelved the earlier proposal, which was never carried out.

sentences.zh: 旋與總督鄂彌達、提督鄭文煥疏言小金川與雜穀、梭磨畫界，以所侵必色多六寨歸雜穀、梭磨；

translations.literal: Soon, together with Governor-General Ermida and Regional Commander Zheng Wenhuan, he memorialized that boundaries be drawn between Lesser Jinchuan and Zagun and Suomo, returning the six villages of Bisaduo that had been seized to Zagun and Suomo;
translations.idiomatic: Soon, together with Governor-General Ermida and Regional Commander Zheng Wenhuan, he memorialized that boundaries be drawn between Lesser Jinchuan and Zagun and Suomo, returning the six seized villages of Bisaduo to Zagun and Suomo;

sentences.zh: 又與沃日畫界，以隴堡等三寨隸沃日，美因等二寨隸小金川。

translations.literal: boundaries were also drawn with Wori, placing the three villages of Longbao and others under Wori and the two villages of Meiyin and others under Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Boundaries were also drawn with Wori, placing the three villages of Longbao and others under Wori and the two villages of Meiyin and others under Lesser Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 大金川與革布什咱二土司構爭，檄建昌道李學裕開諭，革布什咱建轉經樓詛大金川，令即毀除，大金川亦歸所侵蓋古地。

translations.literal: Greater Jinchuan and the two native chieftains of Gebushizan were at odds; an order was sent to Jianchang Circuit Intendant Li Xueyu to instruct them; Gebushizan had built a prayer hall cursing Greater Jinchuan and was ordered to destroy it at once, and Greater Jinchuan also returned the seized territory of Gaigu.
translations.idiomatic: Greater Jinchuan and the two Gebushizan chieftains were at odds; Jianchang Circuit Intendant Li Xueyu was ordered to instruct them; Gebushizan had built a prayer hall cursing Greater Jinchuan and was ordered to destroy it at once, and Greater Jinchuan also returned the seized territory of Gaigu.

sentences.zh: 邊外諸土司亂悉平。

translations.literal: The disorders among the native chieftains beyond the frontier were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The disorders among the frontier native chieftains were all settled.

sentences.zh: 郭羅克番為亂，走匿色利溝，遣兵圍捕，土酋蒙柯縱使走。

translations.literal: When the Geluo tribes rebelled and fled to hide in Seligou, troops were sent to surround and capture them, but the native chieftain Meng Ke secretly allowed them to escape.
translations.idiomatic: When the Geluo tribes rebelled and fled to Seligou, troops were sent to surround and capture them, but the native chieftain Meng Ke secretly allowed them to escape.

sentences.zh: 顯令總兵潘紹週按治，奏聞，上諭曰：「此等事汝固應就近料理，亦當與總督熟商。

translations.literal: Xian ordered Regional Commander Pan Shaozhou to investigate and punish them; when he memorialized the matter, the Emperor instructed: "In such matters you should indeed handle them on the spot, yet you should also consult closely with the governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Xian ordered Regional Commander Pan Shaozhou to investigate and punish them; when he memorialized the matter, the Emperor instructed: "In such matters you should indeed handle them locally, yet you should also consult closely with the governor-general.

sentences.zh: 」總督，黃廷桂也。

translations.literal: " The governor-general was Huang Tinggui.
translations.idiomatic: " The governor-general was Huang Tinggui.

sentences.zh: 四川亂民號侂嚕子，為民害。

translations.literal: In Sichuan, disorderly people called themselves Tuoluzi and harmed the people.
translations.idiomatic: In Sichuan, outlaws calling themselves Tuoluzi were harming the people.

sentences.zh: 顯疏言：「四川自明末兵燹，屠戮殆盡。

translations.literal: Xian memorialized, stating: "Since the wars and devastation of the late Ming, Sichuan was almost wholly slaughtered.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Xian memorialized, stating: "Since the wars and devastation of the late Ming, Sichuan was nearly depopulated.

sentences.zh: 我朝戡定後，各省移民來者多失業之民，姦頑叢集。

translations.literal: After our dynasty pacified the realm, many of the immigrants who came from the provinces were unemployed people, and the wicked and stubborn gathered together.
translations.idiomatic: After our dynasty pacified the realm, many immigrants from other provinces were unemployed people among whom the wicked and stubborn gathered.

sentences.zh: 有所謂侂嚕子，結連黨羽，暗藏刀斧，晝夜盜劫。

translations.literal: There are those called Tuoluzi who band together with accomplices, conceal axes and knives, and rob day and night.
translations.idiomatic: There are men called Tuoluzi who band together, conceal axes and knives, and rob day and night.

sentences.zh: 臣嚴諭捕治，並令編保甲，整塘汛，以清其源。

translations.literal: Your servant has strictly ordered their capture and punishment, and has also ordered the organization of baojia and the strengthening of patrol posts to clear the source of the trouble.
translations.idiomatic: I have strictly ordered their capture and punishment, and have also ordered the organization of baojia and the strengthening of patrol posts to eliminate the problem at its source.

sentences.zh: 」得旨：「實力奉行，毋視為虛文。

translations.literal: " An edict was received: "Carry this out in earnest; do not treat it as empty words.
translations.idiomatic: " The response came: "Carry this out in earnest; do not treat it as empty formality.

sentences.zh: 五年，授廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, appointed governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 時顯方病目，聞命赴新任，上嘉其急公。

translations.literal: At the time Xian was suffering from eye disease; hearing the appointment, he set out for his new post, and the Emperor commended his public-spirited urgency.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Fang Xian was suffering from eye disease; on receiving the appointment he set out for his new post, and the Emperor commended his devotion to public duty.

sentences.zh: 旋請回籍調理，上慰留之。

translations.literal: Soon he requested leave to return home to recuperate, and the Emperor comforted him and kept him in office.
translations.idiomatic: He soon asked to return home to recuperate, and the Emperor comforted him and kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 六年，顯病目未癒，命太醫院選眼科馳往醫治。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because Xian's eye disease had not healed, an ophthalmologist was selected from the Imperial Medical Academy and sent posthaste to treat him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, because Fang Xian's eye disease had not healed, an ophthalmologist was selected from the Imperial Medical Academy and sent posthaste to treat him.

sentences.zh: 尋以疾亟，請告回裡。

translations.literal: Soon, because his illness grew critical, he requested leave and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, as his illness grew critical, he requested leave and returned home.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 顯蒞政明而恕。

translations.literal: In governing, Xian was clear-minded and forgiving.
translations.idiomatic: In office Fang Xian was clear-minded and forgiving.

sentences.zh: 文煥嘗奏顯「爽直坦白，政治勤敏，遇事彼此悉心商榷，推誠共濟」。

translations.literal: Wenhuan once memorialized that Xian was "frank and open, diligent and alert in administration, meeting affairs with wholehearted consultation between them, joining sincerity in mutual support."
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Wenhuan once memorialized that Fang Xian was "frank and open, diligent and alert in administration, meeting affairs with wholehearted consultation, joining in sincere mutual support."

sentences.zh: 上嘉文煥論甚正。

translations.literal: The Emperor commended Wenhuan's argument as very correct.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised Zheng Wenhuan's assessment as entirely correct.

sentences.zh: 顯嘗奏薦學裕，因及夔州知府崔景俊「賦性巧滑，以其悛改，姑從寬恕」。

translations.literal: Xian once memorialized recommending Xueyu, and in doing so mentioned Kuizhou Prefect Cui Jingjun as "by nature crafty and slippery; since he has repented and reformed, he is temporarily granted leniency."
translations.idiomatic: Fang Xian once memorialized recommending Li Xueyu and also mentioned Kuizhou Prefect Cui Jingjun as "crafty and slippery by nature; since he has repented and reformed, let him be forgiven for now."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「似此考察屬吏，且宥過錄長，得用人之要矣。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed: "In investigating subordinate officials in this way, pardoning faults while recording strengths, you have grasped the essentials of employing men.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed: "In evaluating subordinates this way—overlooking faults while noting strengths—you have grasped the essentials of employing men.

sentences.zh: 桂，顯子，字友蘭。

translations.literal: Gui was Xian's son, courtesy name Youlan.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was Fang Xian's son; his courtesy name was Youlan.

sentences.zh: 從顯平貴州苗有功，議敘。

translations.literal: Following Xian, he had merit in pacifying the Miao of Guizhou, and his service was considered for reward.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Fang Xian in pacifying the Miao of Guizhou with merit, and his service was considered for reward.

sentences.zh: 父喪終，以知縣發廣東，補英德，調潮陽。

translations.literal: When his period of mourning for his father ended, he was sent to Guangdong as a magistrate, assigned to Yingde, then transferred to Chaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: After completing mourning for his father, he was sent to Guangdong as a magistrate, assigned to Yingde and then transferred to Chaoyang.

sentences.zh: 以善​​折獄名。

translations.literal: He became known for skill in deciding cases.
translations.idiomatic: He became known for skill in settling lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 舉卓異，擢雲南昆陽知州，署安寧。

translations.literal: Cited for outstanding performance, he was promoted to prefect of Kunyang in Yunnan and served concurrently at Anning.
translations.idiomatic: Rated outstanding in performance, he was promoted to prefect of Kunyang in Yunnan and served concurrently at Anning.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，擢臨安知府，署澂江。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Qianlong, promoted to prefect of Lin'an, serving concurrently at Chengjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of the Qianlong reign he was promoted to prefect of Lin'an and served concurrently at Chengjiang.

sentences.zh: 調東川，丁母憂。

translations.literal: Transferred to Dongchuan; entered mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Dongchuan, then entered mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 服除，授甘肅鞏昌知府。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, appointed prefect of Gongchang in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, he was appointed prefect of Gongchang in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 鞏昌及平涼、慶陽三府飢，詔發西安籓庫銀六十萬治賑，大吏檄桂任其事。

translations.literal: Gongchang and the prefectures of Pingliang and Qingyang suffered famine; an edict ordered 600,000 taels of silver from the Xi'an provincial treasury for relief; the chief officials ordered Gui to take charge.
translations.idiomatic: When Gongchang and the prefectures of Pingliang and Qingyang suffered famine, an edict ordered 600,000 taels from the Xi'an provincial treasury for relief, and the chief officials assigned Gui to handle it.

sentences.zh: 至平涼，饑民待食急，適部撥城工銀三十萬先至，桂以便宜留治賑，饑民賴以全。

translations.literal: Arriving at Pingliang, the hungry people urgently awaited food; just then 300,000 taels allocated from the ministry for city works arrived first; Gui retained them by special authority for relief, and the hungry people were saved thereby.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Pingliang the starving people urgently needed food; just then 300,000 taels allocated from the ministry for city works arrived first, and Gui retained them on his own authority for relief, saving the starving people.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，遷浙江寧紹台道。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, transferred to the Ning-Shao-Tai Circuit of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he was transferred to the Ning-Shao-Tai Circuit of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 故事，定海戰艦九歲更造，則移致寧波船廠，取其值輸之官，名曰「折變」。

translations.literal: By precedent, when Dinghai warships were rebuilt every nine years, they were transferred to the Ningbo shipyard and their value paid to the government, a practice called "zhebian."
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, when Dinghai warships were rebuilt every nine years they were transferred to the Ningbo shipyard and their value remitted to the government—a practice called "conversion payment."

sentences.zh: 奉檄裁戰艦，桂請視時值倍之，部駁坐短估，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: Ordered to reduce warships, Gui requested valuation at double the current price; the ministry rejected this as undervaluation and sentenced him to frontier service at Yili.
translations.idiomatic: When ordered to reduce warships, Gui asked that they be valued at double the current price; the ministry rejected this as undervaluation and sentenced him to exile at Yili.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，放還。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, released and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year he was released and returned home.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: =馮光裕=馮光裕，字叔益，山西代州人。

translations.literal: Feng Guangyu, courtesy name Shuyi, a native of Daizhou in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guangyu, courtesy name Shuyi, was a native of Daizhou in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十年舉人。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year of Kangxi, a provincial graduate.
translations.idiomatic: He became a provincial graduate in the fiftieth year of the Kangxi reign.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，以薦授雲南大姚知縣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, by recommendation appointed magistrate of Dayao in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Yongzheng reign he was recommended and appointed magistrate of Dayao in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 大姚賦少而耗重，積逋數万。

translations.literal: Dayao had little tax quota but heavy surcharges, with accumulated arrears of tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Dayao had a small tax quota but heavy surcharges, with accumulated arrears of tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 光裕不取耗，視負尤多者薄責之，逋賦悉清。

translations.literal: Guangyu took no surcharges, and for those especially heavily in arrears he levied lighter demands; all overdue taxes were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guangyu collected no surcharges and imposed lighter demands on those most heavily in arrears; all overdue taxes were cleared.

sentences.zh: 民以耗重故，輒寄大戶造偽券佔田，吏毀其籍。

translations.literal: Because the surcharges were heavy, the people would attach themselves to great households to forge deeds and seize land; officials destroyed their records.
translations.idiomatic: Because surcharges were heavy, people would attach themselves to wealthy households to forge deeds and seize land, and officials destroyed their records.

sentences.zh: 光裕檢毀未盡者藏之，按牒辨其偽，歸田故主，民尤頌之。

translations.literal: Guangyu collected what had not been fully destroyed and kept it, verified the deeds to distinguish forgeries, returned the land to its original owners, and the people praised him especially.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guangyu collected records not fully destroyed and kept them, verified deeds to expose forgeries, returned land to its original owners, and the people praised him all the more.

sentences.zh: 遷貴州銅仁同知，赴闕引見。

translations.literal: Transferred to sub-prefect of Tongren in Guizhou; went to court for audience.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to sub-prefect of Tongren in Guizhou and went to court for an audience.

sentences.zh: 時古州苗方亂，世宗詢及之，光裕對苗不可盡殺，宜隨機化導，令歸版圖，上韙其言。

translations.literal: At the time the Guzhou Miao were in rebellion; the Yongzheng Emperor inquired about it; Guangyu replied that the Miao could not all be killed, that they should be guided and transformed as occasion required and brought back under the realm; the Emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Guzhou Miao were rebelling; the Yongzheng Emperor inquired about them, and Feng Guangyu replied that the Miao could not all be killed but should be guided and transformed as occasion allowed and brought back under imperial rule; the Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 既行，擢思州知府，未任，改雲南永北。

translations.literal: After he departed, promoted to prefect of Sizhou, but before taking office was changed to Yongbei in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: After he departed he was promoted to prefect of Sizhou, but before taking office was reassigned to Yongbei in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 永北介金沙江外，與四川連界，苗、倮窟其中，有事則兩界相諉。

translations.literal: Yongbei lay beyond the Jinsha River, bordering Sichuan; Miao and Luo tribes lurked within, and when trouble arose the two jurisdictions blamed each other.
translations.idiomatic: Yongbei lay beyond the Jinsha River bordering Sichuan; Miao and Luo tribes lurked there, and when trouble arose the two jurisdictions blamed each other.

sentences.zh: 總督鄂爾泰命往勘，光裕輕騎往，倮從谷中出，挺刃相向。

translations.literal: Governor-General Ortai ordered him to go investigate; Guangyu went with a light escort; Luo emerged from the valley and brandished blades against him.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Ortai ordered him to investigate; Feng Guangyu went with a light escort, and Luo emerged from the valley with blades drawn against him.

sentences.zh: 光裕策馬前，諭以利害，倮羅拜聽命，各散去。

translations.literal: Guangyu spurred his horse forward, explained advantage and harm; the Luo bowed and obeyed, and each departed.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guangyu rode forward and explained the stakes; the Luo bowed and obeyed, then dispersed.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰疏請改知麗江，仍兼理永北事。

translations.literal: Ortai memorialized requesting his transfer to magistrate of Lijiang while still concurrently administering Yongbei affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai memorialized requesting that he be transferred to magistrate of Lijiang while still administering Yongbei affairs.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢驛鹽道。

translations.literal: Before long, promoted to the Postal and Salt Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to intendant of the Postal and Salt Circuit.

sentences.zh: 八年，東川、烏蒙倮叛，鄂爾泰檄光裕會鎮將討平之，擢按察使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Luo of Dongchuan and Wumeng rebelled; Ortai ordered Guangyu to join the regional commander in suppressing them; promoted to provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Luo of Dongchuan and Wumeng rebelled; Ortai ordered Feng Guangyu to join the regional commander in suppressing them, after which he was promoted to provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙俘七千人，語不可通，譯者面謾莫能詰。

translations.literal: At Wumeng seven thousand captives spoke unintelligibly; the interpreters brazenly deceived and none could be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: At Wumeng seven thousand captives could not be understood; the interpreters brazenly deceived and none could be interrogated.

sentences.zh: 光裕集群譯於使院，分室居之，訊一人，經數譯乃得其情。

translations.literal: Guangyu gathered the interpreters at the commissionerate, housed them in separate rooms, questioned one person, and only after several interpreters obtained the facts.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guangyu gathered the interpreters at the commissionerate, housed them in separate rooms, and questioned one person through several interpreters before learning the facts.

sentences.zh: 倮姓名多同，為編次年貌，驗決無誤，省釋者甚眾。

translations.literal: Luo names were largely identical; he compiled age and appearance records, verified judgments without error, and many were spared and released.
translations.idiomatic: Luo names were largely identical; he compiled records of age and appearance, verified judgments without error, and many were released.

sentences.zh: 廣西州民李天保以邪教聚眾殆千人，檄光裕按治。

translations.literal: Li Tianbao, a man of Guangxi Prefecture, gathered nearly a thousand people in a heterodox sect; an order was sent to Guangyu to investigate and punish.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tianbao of Guangxi Prefecture gathered nearly a thousand people in a heterodox sect; Feng Guangyu was ordered to investigate and punish.

sentences.zh: 光裕曰：「愚民茹蔬奉佛，非有異志。

translations.literal: Guangyu said: "Foolish people eat vegetables and venerate the Buddha; they have no other intent.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guangyu said: "These common people eat vegetables and venerate the Buddha; they have no subversive intent.

sentences.zh: 」薄其罪，焚籍，置不問。

translations.literal: " He lightened their offenses, burned the registers, and let the matter drop.
translations.idiomatic: " He reduced their sentences, burned the registers, and let the matter drop.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢貴州布政使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, promoted to provincial treasurer of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted to provincial treasurer of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十三年，古州苗叛，都江、清江、八寨、丹江、台拱諸新附苗皆應。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the Guzhou Miao rebelled; the newly submitted Miao of Dujiang, Qingjiang, Bazhai, Danjiang, Taigong, and others all responded.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the Guzhou Miao rebelled, and the newly submitted Miao of Dujiang, Qingjiang, Bazhai, Danjiang, Taigong, and others all joined them.

sentences.zh: 師討之，光裕督餉，令民應役，厚與直，行得持械自衛。

translations.literal: The army went to suppress them; Guangyu supervised supplies, ordered the people to perform corvée, paid them generously, and allowed them to carry weapons for self-defense on the road.
translations.idiomatic: The army marched to suppress them; Feng Guangyu supervised supplies, conscripted the people for labor with generous wages, and allowed them to carry weapons for self-defense on the road.

sentences.zh: 募熟苗為助，畀以木符，戒官兵無妄殺，皆踴躍應募。

translations.literal: He recruited seasoned Miao as assistants, gave them wooden tokens, warned the officers and soldiers not to kill indiscriminately, and all eagerly volunteered.
translations.idiomatic: He recruited experienced Miao as auxiliaries, gave them wooden tokens, warned the troops not to kill indiscriminately, and all eagerly volunteered.

sentences.zh: 師集十餘萬，皆得宿飽。

translations.literal: The army gathered over a hundred thousand, all fed on the march.
translations.idiomatic: The army gathered over a hundred thousand men, all well fed on the march.

sentences.zh: 軍罷，民被兵者無所棲止，給草舍居之，賦以衣食，復業者二十餘萬戶。

translations.literal: When the campaign ended, the people afflicted by war had nowhere to live; he provided grass huts for them, supplied food and clothing, and over two hundred thousand households returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ended, war-affected people had nowhere to live; he provided grass huts, supplied food and clothing, and over two hundred thousand households returned to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 貴州賦銀八萬八千、米十五萬五千，光裕奏請蠲免。

translations.literal: Guizhou's tax levy was 88,000 taels of silver and 155,000 shi of grain; Guangyu memorialized requesting exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou owed 88,000 taels of silver and 155,000 shi of grain in taxes; Feng Guangyu memorialized requesting exemption.

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，命被兵地停徵三年。

translations.literal: When the Qianlong Emperor ascended the throne, he ordered a three-year suspension of collection in war-affected areas.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qianlong Emperor ascended the throne, he ordered a three-year suspension of taxes in war-affected areas.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「古州、丹江諸苗剿除殆盡，荒田空寨，遠近相望。

translations.literal: He further memorialized: "The Miao of Guzhou, Danjiang, and others have been nearly exterminated in suppression; abandoned fields and empty stockades stretch as far as one can see.
translations.idiomatic: He further memorialized: "The Miao of Guzhou, Danjiang, and others have been nearly exterminated; abandoned fields and empty stockades stretch as far as the eye can see.

sentences.zh: 當募民居苗寨，墾苗田，設屯置衛，行保甲法，授降苗所納軍器，俾農隙講肄，以壯聲援、省餽餉。

translations.literal: One should recruit people to dwell in Miao stockades, cultivate Miao fields, establish garrison colonies and military posts, implement the baojia system, distribute weapons surrendered by subdued Miao, and have them drill in agricultural idle time to strengthen support and save rations.
translations.idiomatic: Settlers should be recruited to live in Miao stockades, cultivate abandoned Miao fields, establish garrison colonies and military posts, implement the baojia system, distribute weapons surrendered by subdued Miao, and have them drill in idle farming seasons to strengthen local defense and save rations.

sentences.zh: 」得旨允行。

translations.literal: " The edict granted approval.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年，擢湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong, promoted to governor of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Qianlong reign he was promoted to governor of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 鎮筸紅苗叛，光裕督兵捕治，不三月而平。

translations.literal: The Red Miao of Zhenqian rebelled; Guangyu directed troops to capture and suppress them, pacifying them in less than three months.
translations.idiomatic: The Red Miao of Zhenqian rebelled; Feng Guangyu directed troops to suppress them and pacified the region in less than three months.

sentences.zh: 疾，乞假，聞城步、綏寧苗复勾結粵瑤為亂，密諮兩廣總督籌協捕。

translations.literal: Ill, he requested leave; hearing that the Miao of Chengbu and Suining again colluded with Yao of Guangdong in rebellion, he secretly consulted the Governor-General of Liangguang on coordinated suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Ill, he requested leave; on hearing that the Miao of Chengbu and Suining were again colluding with Yao rebels from Guangdong, he secretly consulted the Governor-General of Liangguang on joint suppression.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died.

sentences.zh: 遺疏猶言：「二縣困於兵，請免今年租。

translations.literal: His final memorial still stated: "The two counties are distressed by war; I request exemption from this year's land tax.
translations.idiomatic: His deathbed memorial still stated: "The two counties are distressed by war; I request exemption from this year's land tax.

sentences.zh: 」上從其請。

translations.literal: " The Emperor granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: " His request was granted.

sentences.zh: 子祁，乾隆二年進士，官編修。

translations.literal: His son Qi, a jinshi in the second year of Qianlong, served as reviser.
translations.idiomatic: His son Qi passed the jinshi examination in the second year of the Qianlong reign and served as a Hanlin reviser.

sentences.zh: 孫廷丞，舉人，以廕生授光祿寺署正，官至湖北按察使。

translations.literal: His grandson Tingcheng, a provincial graduate, entered office by yinsheng privilege as acting director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and rose to provincial judicial commissioner of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Tingcheng, a provincial graduate, entered office through yinsheng privilege as acting director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and rose to provincial judicial commissioner of Hubei.

sentences.zh: =楊錫紱=楊錫紱，字方來，江西清江人。

translations.literal: Yang Xifu, courtesy name Fanglai, a native of Qingjiang in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xifu, courtesy name Fanglai, was a native of Qingjiang in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年進士，授吏部主事。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the fifth year of Yongzheng, appointed a principal clerk in the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: After passing the jinshi examination in the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign, he was appointed a principal clerk in the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中。

translations.literal: Promoted repeatedly to department director.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to department director.

sentences.zh: 考選貴州道御史。

translations.literal: Selected by examination as censor of the Guizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was selected by examination as censor of the Guizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十年，授廣東肇羅道。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, appointed intendant of the Zhao-Luo Circuit in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed intendant of the Zhao-Luo Circuit in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 肇慶瀕海，藉圍基衛田。

translations.literal: Zhaoqing bordered the sea and relied on polder fields for coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoqing bordered the sea and relied on polder embankment fields for coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 歲親蒞修築，終任無水患。

translations.literal: Each year he personally oversaw repairs and construction; throughout his tenure there were no flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: Each year he personally supervised repairs, and throughout his tenure there were no floods.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，署廣西布政使，尋實授。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, acting provincial treasurer of Guangxi; soon formally appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign he served as acting provincial treasurer of Guangxi and was soon formally appointed.

sentences.zh: 請禁州縣以土產餽上官。

translations.literal: He requested a ban on prefectures and counties presenting local products to superiors.
translations.idiomatic: He requested a ban on prefectures and counties presenting local products to their superiors.

sentences.zh: 六年，授廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, appointed governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was appointed governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 貴州土苗石金元為亂，焚永從縣治。

translations.literal: Shi Jinyuan, a native Miao of Guizhou, rebelled and burned the seat of Yongcong County.
translations.idiomatic: The native Miao Shi Jinyuan of Guizhou rebelled and burned the county seat of Yongcong.

sentences.zh: 會貴州、湖廣兵剿擒之。

translations.literal: Guizhou and Huguang troops jointly suppressed and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou and Huguang troops jointly suppressed the rebellion and captured him.

sentences.zh: 既而遷江土苗復為亂，謀犯思恩府。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the native Miao of Qianjiang again rebelled and plotted to attack Si'en Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the native Miao of Qianjiang rebelled again and plotted to attack Si'en Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 檄兵往捕，得其渠李尚彩及其黨八十餘。

translations.literal: Troops were dispatched to capture them; the ringleader Li Shangcai and over eighty of his followers were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were dispatched to capture them, seizing the ringleader Li Shangcai and over eighty of his followers.

sentences.zh: 七年，奏言：「廣西未行保甲。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he memorialized: "Guangxi has not yet implemented baojia.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he memorialized: "Guangxi has not yet implemented the baojia system.

sentences.zh: 苗、僮雖殊種，多聚族而居，原有頭人，略諳事體。

translations.literal: Miao and Zhuang, though distinct peoples, mostly live in clan communities and already have headmen who understand local affairs somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Miao and Zhuang, though distinct peoples, mostly live in clan communities and already have headmen who understand local affairs.

sentences.zh: 請因其舊制，寓以稽覈。

translations.literal: I request that their old institutions be adapted to embed supervision and verification.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that their existing institutions be adapted to embed supervision and verification.

sentences.zh: 苗、瑤、伶、僮各就其俗為變通。

translations.literal: For Miao, Yao, Ling, and Zhuang, adapt flexibly according to each group's customs.
translations.idiomatic: For Miao, Yao, Ling, and Zhuang, let the system be adapted flexibly to each group's customs.

sentences.zh: 」詔嘉之。

translations.literal: " An edict commended this.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne commended this.

sentences.zh: 尋又奏言：「設兵以衛民，乃反以累民：城守兵欺凌負販，攫取薪蔬；

translations.literal: Soon he further memorialized: "Troops are established to protect the people, yet they instead burden the people: garrison soldiers bully petty vendors and seize firewood and vegetables;
translations.idiomatic: Soon he further memorialized: "Troops are meant to protect the people, yet they burden them instead: garrison soldiers bully petty vendors and seize firewood and vegetables;

sentences.zh: 塘汛兵驅役村莊，恣為飲博。

translations.literal: patrol-post soldiers press villages into service and indulge freely in drinking and gambling.
translations.idiomatic: patrol-post soldiers press villages into corvée and indulge freely in drinking and gambling.

sentences.zh: 臣於撫標訪察懲治，請敕封疆大臣共相釐剔。

translations.literal: Your servant has investigated and punished this through the governor's command; I request an edict that frontier officials jointly undertake reform.
translations.idiomatic: I have investigated and punished this through the governor's command and ask that frontier officials be ordered to undertake joint reform.

sentences.zh: 」得旨允行。

translations.literal: " The edict granted approval.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 八年，梧州知府戴肇名餽人葠，詭其名曰「長生果」，卻之，具以聞，上諭曰：「汝可謂不愧四知矣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Wuzhou Prefect Dai Zhaoming presented ginseng as a gift, calling it falsely "Longevity Fruit"; he refused it and reported fully; the Emperor instructed: "You may be said not to disgrace the Four Knowings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Wuzhou Prefect Dai Zhaoming presented ginseng as a gift, falsely calling it "Longevity Fruit"; Yang Xifu refused it and reported the matter; the Emperor said: "You may truly be said not to disgrace the Four Knowings.

sentences.zh: 」廣西民有逃入安南者，捕得下諸獄，疏聞，上命重處，錫紱即杖殺之。

translations.literal: " Some Guangxi people who had fled to Annam were captured and imprisoned; when he reported this, the Emperor ordered severe punishment; Xifu immediately had them beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: " Some Guangxi people who had fled to Annam were captured and imprisoned; when he reported this, the Emperor ordered severe punishment, and Yang Xifu immediately had them beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「朕前批示，令其具讞明正典刑。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed: "My previous annotation ordered that a full case report be prepared and proper law applied.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed: "My previous order required a full case report and proper legal proceedings.

sentences.zh: 乃錫紱誤會，即斃杖下。

translations.literal: Yet Xifu misunderstood and immediately had them beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yang Xifu misunderstood and immediately had them beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 此皆當死罪人，設使不應死者死，則死者不可復生矣。

translations.literal: These were all criminals deserving death; yet if one who should not die were killed, the dead cannot be brought back to life.
translations.idiomatic: These were all men who deserved death; yet if one who should not have died were killed, the dead cannot be restored to life.

sentences.zh: 」下部議處。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to the boards for deliberation on punishment.
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was referred to the boards for disciplinary deliberation.

sentences.zh: 九年，授禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, appointed Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十年，授湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, appointed governor of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed governor of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「周禮：遂人治野，百里之間，為澮者一，為洫者百，為溝者萬，捐膏腴之地以為溝洫。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Rites of Zhou: the suiren oversaw the countryside; within a hundred li there was one hui, a hundred xu, and ten thousand gou; fertile land was sacrificed for ditches and canals.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The Rites of Zhou states that the suiren oversaw the countryside: within a hundred li there was one hui, a hundred xu, and ten thousand gou—fertile land was sacrificed for ditches and canals.

sentences.zh: 誠以蓄洩有時，則旱潦不為患，所棄小、所利大也。

translations.literal: Truly, when storage and discharge were timely, drought and flood did not become disasters; what was abandoned was small, what was gained was great.
translations.idiomatic: For when storage and discharge were timely, drought and flood did not become disasters—the sacrifice was small and the benefit great.

sentences.zh: 後世阡陌既開，溝洫雖廢，然陂澤池塘尚與田畝相依，近水則腴，遠水則瘠。

translations.literal: In later ages, once field paths were opened, ditches and canals though abandoned, yet ponds and reservoirs still depended on the fields; near water they were fertile, far from water they were poor.
translations.idiomatic: In later ages, once field boundaries were opened, ditches and canals fell into disuse, yet ponds and reservoirs still depended on the fields—near water they were fertile, far from water they were poor.

sentences.zh: 湖南濱臨洞庭，愚民昧於遠計，往往廢水利而圖田工。

translations.literal: Hunan borders Lake Dongting; foolish people ignorant of long-term planning often abandoned water conservancy to pursue field reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan borders Lake Dongting; common people short-sighted in their planning often abandoned water conservancy to pursue field reclamation.

sentences.zh: 甚至數畝之塘，培土改田；

translations.literal: Some even filled ponds of a few mu to convert them to fields;
translations.idiomatic: Some even filled in ponds of only a few mu to turn them into farmland;

sentences.zh: 一灣之澗，絕流種蓺。

translations.literal: a single bend of a stream was dammed to plant crops.
translations.idiomatic: a single stream bend was dammed to plant crops.

sentences.zh: 彼徒狃於雨暘時若，以為無害；

translations.literal: They merely accustomed themselves to timely rain and sunshine and thought it harmless;
translations.idiomatic: They merely took timely weather for granted and thought it harmless;

sentences.zh: 不知偶值旱澇，得不償失。

translations.literal: not knowing that should drought or flood occur by chance, the gain would not repay the loss.
translations.idiomatic: not knowing that should drought or flood strike, the loss would outweigh the gain.

sentences.zh: 且溪澗之水，遠近所資，若截墾為田，則上溢下漫，無不受累。

translations.literal: Moreover, stream and brook water is relied on near and far; if dammed and reclaimed as fields, overflow above and flooding below would afflict all.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, stream and brook water serves communities near and far; if dammed and reclaimed as fields, overflow upstream and flooding downstream would afflict everyone.

sentences.zh: 官吏以改則昇科為勸墾之功，亦復貪利忘害，溝洫遂致盡廢。

translations.literal: Officials, treating grade upgrades for reclamation as encouragement of cultivation, likewise forgot harm for profit, and ditches and canals thus came to be entirely abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, treating grade upgrades as rewards for reclamation, likewise put profit ahead of safety, and ditches and canals were abandoned entirely.

sentences.zh: 臣以為關係水利，當以地予水而後水不為害，田亦受益。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that where water conservancy is concerned, land should be given to water first, and only then will water not become harmful and fields also benefit.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that on matters of water conservancy, land must be reserved for water first—only then will water cease to be harmful and fields also benefit.

sentences.zh: 請敕各省督撫，凡有池塘陂澤處所，嚴禁改墾。

translations.literal: I request an edict to governors-general and governors of each province strictly forbidding reclamation wherever there are ponds, reservoirs, and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that governors-general and governors of every province be ordered strictly to forbid converting ponds, reservoirs, and marshes into farmland.

sentences.zh: 」上以各省米價騰貴，諭各督撫體察陳奏，錫紱疏言：「米貴由於積漸。

translations.literal: " The Emperor, because rice prices in the provinces were rising sharply, instructed each governor-general and governor to investigate and report; Xifu memorialized: "Rice is costly because of gradual accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: " Because rice prices in the provinces were rising sharply, the Emperor instructed each governor-general and governor to investigate and report; Yang Xifu memorialized: "The high price of rice stems from long-term trends.

sentences.zh: 上諭謂處處積貯，年年採買，民間所出，半入倉庾，此為米貴之一端。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed that everywhere grain was stored up and every year purchases were made; of what the people produced, half went into granaries—this was one cause of costly rice.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor noted that everywhere grain was stockpiled and purchases were made year after year; half of what the people produced went into granaries—this was one reason rice grew costly.

sentences.zh: 臣生長鄉村，世勤耕作，見康熙間石不過二三錢，雍正間需四五錢，今則五六錢。

translations.literal: Your servant grew up in the countryside and from generation to generation tilled diligently; in Kangxi a shi cost no more than two or three cash, in Yongzheng four or five cash were needed, and now five or six cash.
translations.idiomatic: I grew up in the countryside in a farming family; in the Kangxi reign a shi of grain cost no more than two or three cash, in Yongzheng four or five, and now five or six.

sentences.zh: 戶口多則需穀多，價亦逐漸加增。

translations.literal: When population is large then grain needed is great, and prices also gradually increase.
translations.idiomatic: A larger population requires more grain, and prices rise accordingly.

sentences.zh: 國初人經離亂，俗尚樸醇。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty people had passed through chaos, and custom still valued plain simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: In the dynasty's early years people had endured chaos, and customs still favored plain simplicity.

sentences.zh: 數十年後，漸習奢靡，揭借為常，力田不給。

translations.literal: After several decades they gradually grew accustomed to luxury; borrowing on interest became routine, and tilling the fields could not supply needs.
translations.idiomatic: After several decades people gradually turned to luxury; borrowing at interest became routine, and farm work no longer sufficed.

sentences.zh: 甫屆冬春，農糴於巿，穀乃愈乏。

translations.literal: As soon as early winter and spring arrived, farmers bought grain in the market, and grain became even scarcer.
translations.idiomatic: As winter turned to spring, farmers bought grain in the market, and supplies grew even tighter.

sentences.zh: 承平既久，地值日高，貧民賣田。

translations.literal: Long peace having endured, land values rose daily, and poor people sold their fields.
translations.idiomatic: After long peace, land values rose steadily, and the poor sold their fields.

sentences.zh: 既賣無力复買，田歸富戶十之五六。

translations.literal: Once sold, they lacked the strength to buy back; five or six tenths of fields passed to wealthy households.
translations.idiomatic: Once sold, they could not afford to buy back; five or six tenths of farmland passed to wealthy households.

sentences.zh: 富戶穀不輕售，巿者多而售者寡，其值安得不增？

translations.literal: Wealthy households did not lightly sell grain; in the market buyers were many and sellers few—how could the price not rise?
translations.idiomatic: Wealthy households would not sell grain readily; buyers outnumbered sellers—how could prices fail to rise?

sentences.zh: 臣以為生齒滋繁，無可議者。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that population growth cannot be disputed.
translations.idiomatic: I believe population growth is beyond dispute.

sentences.zh: 田歸富戶，非均田不可，今難以施行。

translations.literal: Fields passing to wealthy households cannot be remedied except by equal-field distribution, which is hard to implement now.
translations.idiomatic: Land passing to the wealthy cannot be remedied except through equal land distribution, which cannot be implemented now.

sentences.zh: 風俗奢靡，止可徐徐化導，不能遽收其效。

translations.literal: Luxurious customs can only be slowly transformed and guided; results cannot be quickly achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Luxurious customs can only be changed through gradual moral guidance; results cannot come quickly.

sentences.zh: 至常平積貯，當以足敷賑濟而止，不必過多。

translations.literal: As for Ever-Normal Granary stockpiles, they should stop when sufficient for relief; there need not be excess.
translations.idiomatic: As for Ever-Normal Granary reserves, they should suffice for relief and no more—there is no need for excess.

sentences.zh: 目今養民之政，尤宜專意講求水利，使蓄洩有備，偏災不能為患。

translations.literal: In policies for nourishing the people today, water conservancy especially deserves concentrated attention, so that storage and discharge are provided for and partial disasters cannot become calamities.
translations.idiomatic: Among policies for sustaining the people today, water conservancy deserves special attention, so that storage and drainage are assured and localized disasters cannot become calamities.

sentences.zh: 以期產穀之多，未必非補救米貴之一道也。

translations.literal: In hope of abundant grain production, this may not fail to be one means of remedying costly rice.
translations.idiomatic: By increasing grain production, this may well be one remedy for costly rice.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，上均嘉納焉。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, the Emperor approved all with praise.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, the Emperor approved it all with praise.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，服闋，十五年，授刑部侍郎，仍授湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Upon his father's death he entered mourning; when mourning ended, in the fifteenth year he was appointed Vice Minister of Punishments and again appointed governor of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his father's death, in the fifteenth year he was appointed Vice Minister of Punishments and again assigned as governor of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服闋，十八年，仍授湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Upon his mother's death he entered mourning; when mourning ended, in the eighteenth year he was again appointed governor of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother's death, in the eighteenth year he was again appointed governor of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 擢左都御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was elevated to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十九年，署吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, he served as acting Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he served as acting Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎張泰開保同部侍郎鄒一桂子志伊為國子監學錄，下吏部議處，議未當，責錫紱曲庇，下都察院，議奪官，命留任。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Taikai recommended fellow Vice Minister Zou Yigui's son Zhiyi as academicien-expositor of the Imperial Academy; the matter was referred to the Board of Personnel for deliberation; when the deliberation was improper, Xifu was blamed for favoritism; the matter went to the Censorate, which recommended stripping his rank, but he was ordered to remain in office.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Taikai recommended fellow Vice Minister Zou Yigui's son Zhiyi for the post of academicien-expositor of the Imperial Academy; the Board of Personnel deliberated on the case and found its recommendation improper; Yang Xifu was blamed for showing favor; the Censorate recommended that he be stripped of rank, but he was ordered to remain in office.

sentences.zh: 二十年，复署湖南巡撫，授禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, he again served as governor of Hunan and was appointed Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he again served as governor of Hunan and was appointed Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，署山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, he served as acting governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he served as acting governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，授漕運總督，疏請豁興武、江淮二衛旗丁欠繳漕項，上責其沽名，命以養廉代償。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, appointed Grand Canal Transport Director-General; he memorialized requesting remission of grain-transport payments owed by bannermen of the Xingwu and Jianghuai guards; the Emperor rebuked him for seeking reputation and ordered that integrity-nourishment stipends be used for compensation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was appointed Director-General of Grain Transport; he memorialized asking remission of transport payments owed by bannermen of the Xingwu and Jianghuai guards; the Emperor rebuked him for grandstanding and ordered that integrity stipends cover the compensation.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，疏言：「屯田取贖，宜寬年限。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, he memorialized: "Redemption of garrison farmland should have extended terms.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he memorialized: "Redemption of garrison farmland should allow more time.

sentences.zh: 價百金以上，許三年交價，價足田即歸船。

translations.literal: For prices above a hundred taels of silver, payment over three years should be permitted; once the price is paid the field reverts to the boat.
translations.idiomatic: For prices above a hundred taels of silver, payment over three years should be allowed; once the price is paid the field reverts to the transport unit.

sentences.zh: 旗丁交兌不足，名曰'掛欠'。

translations.literal: When bannermen failed to deliver fully at exchange, it was called "hanging debt."
translations.idiomatic: When bannermen failed to deliver their full quota at exchange, it was called "outstanding arrears."

sentences.zh: 應由坐糧廳限追懲治，督運官以下有一丁掛欠，即停其議敘，旗丁改僉。

translations.literal: The Zuo Liang Hall should set deadlines for pursuit and punishment; if even one bannerman under a transport supervisor or lower had hanging debt, his merit deliberation should be suspended and bannermen reassigned.
translations.idiomatic: The Zuo Liang Hall should set deadlines for collection and punishment; if even one bannerman under a transport supervisor had outstanding arrears, merit review should be suspended and bannermen reassigned.

sentences.zh: 新丁但交篷桅槓索價值；

translations.literal: New recruits need only pay the value of sails, masts, poles, and rope;
translations.idiomatic: New recruits need only pay for sails, masts, poles, and rope;

sentences.zh: 舊丁公私欠項，不得勒新丁接受。

translations.literal: public and private debts of old recruits must not be forced upon new recruits to accept.
translations.idiomatic: old recruits' public and private debts must not be forced on new recruits.

sentences.zh: 水次兌漕，令倉役執斛，旗丁執概。

translations.literal: At the water-exchange point for grain transport, granary clerks should hold the measure and bannermen hold the leveling rod.
translations.idiomatic: At the waterfront exchange point, granary clerks should hold the measuring vessel and bannermen the leveling rod.

sentences.zh: 江淮、興武二衛運丁運糧，快丁駕船。

translations.literal: Transport bannermen of the Jianghuai and Xingwu guards transport grain; courier bannermen sail the boats.
translations.idiomatic: Transport bannermen of the Jianghuai and Xingwu guards carry the grain; courier bannermen sail the boats.

sentences.zh: 應循例並僉，不得避運就快。

translations.literal: They should according to precedent all be assigned together, and must not avoid transport to take courier duty.
translations.idiomatic: Both should be assigned together as precedent requires; no one may avoid transport duty by taking courier assignments.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「此奏確有所見。

translations.literal: " The Emperor instructed: "This memorial has definite insight.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "This memorial shows genuine insight.

sentences.zh: 」下部議，從之。

translations.literal: " It was referred to the boards for deliberation and approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The boards deliberated and approved it.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，疏言：「自開中河，漕艘得避黃河之險。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, he memorialized: "Since the Middle Canal was opened, transport vessels could avoid the Yellow River's dangers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he memorialized: "Since the Middle Canal was opened, transport vessels have been able to avoid the dangers of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 獨江北、長淮等幫，以在徐州交兌，不能避險。

translations.literal: Only the Jiangbei, Changhuai, and other detachments, because they exchanged at Xuzhou, could not avoid the danger.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Jiangbei, Changhuai, and other detachments, because they exchanged at Xuzhou, could not avoid those dangers.

sentences.zh: 請令改泊皁河，弁丁詣徐州受兌。

translations.literal: I request that they be ordered to moor instead at the Zao River, with officers and bannermen going to Xuzhou to receive exchange.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that they be ordered to moor at the Zao River instead, with officers and bannermen going to Xuzhou to receive the transfer.

sentences.zh: 州縣代僱剝船轉運過壩。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties should hire barge-boats on their behalf to transfer grain past the lock.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties should hire lighter boats to transfer the grain past the lock.

sentences.zh: 」上從之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 尋以錫紱實心治事，命免以養廉代償漕項。

translations.literal: Soon, because Xifu served conscientiously, he was ordered exempted from paying compensation for transport payments with integrity stipends.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, because Yang Xifu served conscientiously, he was exempted from covering the transport payments with integrity stipends.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，疏言：「運薊州糧船自寧河轉入寶坻，由白龍港、劉家莊達薊州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, he memorialized: "Grain boats transporting to Jizhou turn from Ninghe into Baodi, reaching Jizhou via Bailong Harbor and Liujiazhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he memorialized: "Grain boats bound for Jizhou turn from Ninghe into Baodi and reach Jizhou via Bailong Harbor and Liujiazhuang.

sentences.zh: 水道淤淺，請責成官為疏濬。

translations.literal: The waterway is silted and shallow; I request that responsible officials be charged with dredging.
translations.idiomatic: The waterway is silted and shallow; I ask that responsible officials be charged with dredging it.

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「板閘、臨清、天津三關，尚沿明製，漕艘給發限單，應請裁革。

translations.literal: " He further memorialized: "The three passes at Banzha, Linqing, and Tianjin still follow Ming practice in issuing limit-slips to transport vessels; these should be requested abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " He further memorialized: "The three passes at Banzha, Linqing, and Tianjin still follow Ming practice in issuing transit permits to transport vessels; I ask that this be abolished.

sentences.zh: 州縣收漕如有攙雜潮潤，糧道察出，本管知府視徇庇劣員例議處。

translations.literal: If prefectures and counties collecting transport grain adulterate it with dampness, and the grain-route intendant discovers this, the supervising prefect should be deliberated on for punishment according to the precedent for shielding inferior officials.
translations.idiomatic: If prefectures and counties adulterate collected transport grain with moisture and the grain-route intendant discovers it, the supervising prefect should be punished under the precedent for shielding inferior officials.

sentences.zh: 軍丁兼充書役，一體句僉。

translations.literal: Military bannermen who also serve as clerks should all be conscripted together.
translations.idiomatic: Military bannermen who also serve as clerks should all be assigned together.

sentences.zh: 頭舵水手受僱，領費輒复潛逃，請發邊遠充軍。

translations.literal: Headmen, helmsmen, and sailors who are hired, once receiving payment again flee secretly; I request they be sent to distant borders as exiled soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Headmen, helmsmen, and sailors who are hired, take their pay, and then abscond should be sent to distant borders as exiled soldiers.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「所奏俱可行。

translations.literal: " The Emperor instructed: "All that was memorialized is feasible.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "All of this may be adopted.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 加太子少師。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，疏言：「軍、民戶籍各分，既隸軍籍，即應聽僉辦運。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, he memorialized: "Military and civilian household registers are each separate; once enrolled in military registers, one should hear assignment to handle transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he memorialized: "Military and civilian household registers are separate; once enrolled in the military register, one should accept transport assignment.

sentences.zh: 乃宦家富戶百計圖避，所僉皆無力窮民，情理未得其平。

translations.literal: Yet official families and wealthy households use every scheme to avoid it; those assigned are all poor people without means—the balance of reason is not achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Yet official families and the wealthy use every scheme to evade it, while those assigned are all poor and powerless—the balance of justice is not achieved.

sentences.zh: 嗣後如僉報後辨訴審虛，參劾治罪。

translations.literal: Hereafter if, after assignment is reported, appeals prove false upon investigation, impeachment and punishment should follow.
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter if post-assignment appeals prove false upon investigation, the officials involved should be impeached and punished.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「錫紱此奏，破瞻徇之習。

translations.literal: " The Emperor instructed: "Xifu's memorial this time breaks the habit of timidity and favoritism.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "Yang Xifu's memorial breaks the habit of timidity and favoritism.

sentences.zh: 如所議行。

translations.literal: Implement as deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: Implement as proposed.

sentences.zh: 」並下部議敘。

translations.literal: " It was also referred to the boards for merit deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " It was also referred to the boards for merit review.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「糧艘例禁私鹽。

translations.literal: He further memorialized: "Transport vessels are by precedent forbidden private salt.
translations.idiomatic: He further memorialized: "Transport vessels are by regulation forbidden to carry private salt.

sentences.zh: 道經揚州，總督、鹽政及臣各專委督察。

translations.literal: Passing through Yangzhou, the governor-general, salt commissioner, and your servant each specially appointed inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: When passing through Yangzhou, the governor-general, salt commissioner, and I each appointed special inspectors.

sentences.zh: 乃又有淮揚道，揚州游擊、守備，江都、甘泉兩縣，各差兵役搜查，糧艘因之羈阻。

translations.literal: Yet there were also the Huai-Yang circuit, Yangzhou vice commander and garrison commander, and the two counties of Jiangdu and Ganquan, each dispatching soldiers to search—transport vessels were thereby detained and obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Huai-Yang circuit, Yangzhou vice commander and garrison commander, and the counties of Jiangdu and Ganquan each sent troops to search as well—transport vessels were thus detained and delayed.

sentences.zh: 如江廣幫為通漕殿後，過揚州已在冬令，尤為苦累。

translations.literal: For example the Jiang-Guang detachment, bringing up the rear of the transport fleet, passes Yangzhou already in winter—especially burdensome.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Guang detachment, bringing up the rear of the transport fleet, passes Yangzhou already in winter—making the burden especially heavy.

sentences.zh: 臣思事權宜歸​​於一，請專聽總督、鹽政委員督察，餘悉停止。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that authority should be unified; I request that only the governor-general and salt commissioner appoint inspectors, and all others cease.
translations.idiomatic: I believe authority should be unified; I ask that inspection be entrusted solely to commissioners appointed by the governor-general and salt commissioner, and all other inspections cease.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「所奏是。

translations.literal: " The Emperor instructed: "What was memorialized is correct.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "The memorial is correct.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: " It was referred to the boards for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The boards deliberated and implemented it.

sentences.zh: 三十年，疏言：「駱馬湖蓄水，相傳專濟江廣重運。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, he memorialized: "Luoma Lake stores water; tradition says it specifically aids the heavy transport of the Jiang-Guang route.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he memorialized: "Luoma Lake stores water; tradition says it exists chiefly to assist the heavy Jiang-Guang transport route.

sentences.zh: 今歲幫船阻滯，先開柳園堤口，運河水長，江浙幫遂得遄行。

translations.literal: This year fleet boats were delayed; first the Liuyuan dike opening was opened, the canal water rose, and the Jiang-Zhe detachments were thereby able to proceed swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: This year transport boats were delayed; first the Liuyuan dike opening was opened, the canal water rose, and the Jiang-Zhe detachments were able to proceed swiftly.

sentences.zh: 次開王家溝口，江廣幫至，湖水未嘗告竭。

translations.literal: Next Wangjiagou opening was opened; when the Jiang-Guang detachment arrived, the lake water had never been exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Wangjiagou opening was opened; when the Jiang-Guang detachment arrived, the lake had not run dry.

sentences.zh: 每歲沂水自湖而下，為海州、沭陽​​水患。

translations.literal: Every year Yishui flows down from the lake, causing water disasters for Haizhou and Shuyang.
translations.idiomatic: Every year the Yishui flows down from the lake, flooding Haizhou and Shuyang.

sentences.zh: 若於四五月間引湖濟運，亦減海州、沭陽​​水患，一舉兩利。

translations.literal: If in the fourth and fifth months lake water were drawn to aid transport, Haizhou and Shuyang water disasters would also be reduced—one action, two benefits.
translations.idiomatic: If lake water were drawn to aid transport in the fourth and fifth months, flooding in Haizhou and Shuyang would also be reduced—achieving two goals at once.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，卒，賜祭葬，諡勤愨。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, he died; imperial sacrifice and burial were granted, posthumous name Qinque.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he died; he was granted imperial rites of sacrifice and burial, with the posthumous name Qinque.

sentences.zh: 錫紱官漕督十二年，編輯漕運全書，黃登賢代為漕督，表上之。

translations.literal: Xifu served as grain-transport director for twelve years and compiled the Complete Book of Grain Transport; Huang Dengxian replaced him as transport director and submitted it to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xifu served as grain-transport director for twelve years and compiled the Complete Book of Grain Transport; Huang Dengxian, who succeeded him as transport director, submitted it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 自後任漕政者，上輒命遵錫紱舊章。

translations.literal: From then on, those in charge of transport affairs were always ordered by the Emperor to follow Xifu's old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, those placed in charge of transport were always ordered to follow Yang Xifu's earlier regulations.

sentences.zh: =潘思榘=潘思榘，字絜方，江南陽湖人。

translations.literal: Pan Siju, courtesy name Jiefang, a native of Yanghu in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Siju, courtesy name Jiefang, was a native of Yanghu in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年進士，改庶吉士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the second year of Yongzheng, he was changed to Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of the second year of Yongzheng, he was appointed a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 三年，分刑部學習。

translations.literal: In the third year, assigned to study in the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was assigned to the Board of Punishments for training.

sentences.zh: 六年，補主事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, appointed chief clerk.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was appointed a chief clerk.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was progressively promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: He was steadily promoted to director.

sentences.zh: 八年，授廣東南雄知府。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, appointed prefect of Nanxiong in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed prefect of Nanxiong in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 驟雨水溢，郊野成巨浸，露宿於野。

translations.literal: Sudden rain caused flooding; suburbs and countryside became vast inundation; he slept in the open in the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Sudden rains caused flooding; suburbs and countryside were submerged; he slept outdoors in the fields.

sentences.zh: 督吏卒治筏拯溺，出金瘞死贍生，活民無算。

translations.literal: He supervised clerks and soldiers in building rafts to rescue the drowned, spent gold to bury the dead and sustain the living, and saved countless people.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised officials and soldiers in building rafts to rescue the drowning, spent his own funds to bury the dead and sustain the living, and saved countless lives.

sentences.zh: 十三年，遷海南道。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, transferred to Hainan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Hainan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 濬瓊州西湖。

translations.literal: He dredged the West Lake of Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged Qiongzhou's West Lake.

sentences.zh: 深入五指山，安輯黎眾，劾守將之殘黎民者。

translations.literal: He penetrated deep into Wuzhi Mountain, pacified the Li people, and impeached garrison commanders who brutalized the Li people.
translations.idiomatic: He penetrated deep into Wuzhi Mountain, pacified the Li people, and impeached garrison commanders who brutalized them.

sentences.zh: 調糧驛道。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Grain and Courier Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned to the Grain and Courier Circuit.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年，遷按察使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong, transferred to provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Qianlong he was promoted to provincial surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 懲貪鉏猾，理冤獄尤多。

translations.literal: He punished greed and uprooted the cunning, and especially often rectified wrongful cases.
translations.idiomatic: He punished corruption and uprooted scoundrels, and rectified wrongful cases in particular abundance.

sentences.zh: 民以旱糾眾入巿掠奪，思榘方被疾，強起坐堂皇，立捕數十人杖以徇，事乃定。

translations.literal: Because of drought the people gathered in a crowd to enter the market and plunder; Siju was then ill but forcibly sat up in the hall of justice, immediately arrested several dozen men and flogged them as a public example, and the matter was settled.
translations.idiomatic: During a drought people gathered to loot the market; Pan Siju was ill but forced himself to sit up in court, immediately arrested several dozen men and flogged them publicly, and order was restored.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「廣東有俍、瑤、黎三種：俍世居茂名，今附民籍，讀書應試如平民。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Guangdong has three groups—Liang, Yao, and Li: the Liang long dwelt in Maoming and now attach to civilian registers, studying and sitting for examinations like common people.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Guangdong has three peoples—the Liang, Yao, and Li: the Liang have long lived in Maoming and now attach to civilian registers, studying and sitting for examinations like commoners.

sentences.zh: 瑤亦輸稅歸誠，設瑤童義學為訓課。

translations.literal: The Yao also pay taxes and submit in loyalty; Yao children's charity schools are established for instruction.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao also pay taxes and submit in loyalty; charity schools for Yao children are established for their instruction.

sentences.zh: 惟黎僻處海南，崖、儋、萬、陵水、昌化、感恩、定安七州縣為最多。

translations.literal: Only the Li dwell remotely in Hainan; the seven prefectures and counties of Ya, Dan, Wan, Lingshui, Changhua, Gan'en, and Ding'an have the most.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Li live remotely in Hainan; they are most numerous in the seven jurisdictions of Ya, Dan, Wan, Lingshui, Changhua, Gan'en, and Ding'an.

sentences.zh: 生黎居深山，熟黎錯居民間相往來，語言相習，請於此七州縣視瑤童例設義學，擇師教誨，能通文義者許應試。

translations.literal: Raw Li dwell in deep mountains; assimilated Li live intermingled among the people and visit one another; languages are mutually familiar; I request that in these seven prefectures and counties charity schools be established following the Yao children's precedent, teachers chosen for instruction, and those able to understand literary meaning permitted to sit for examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Raw Li live in deep mountains while assimilated Li mingle among the people and interact freely; their languages are mutually intelligible; I ask that charity schools be established in these seven jurisdictions following the Yao children's precedent, with teachers chosen to instruct them, and those able to read and write permitted to sit for examinations.

sentences.zh: 」部議從之。

translations.literal: " The board deliberated and approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The board approved after deliberation.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷浙江布政使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, transferred to provincial treasurer of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted to provincial treasurer of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 八年，疏言：「常平倉穀春發秋斂。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he memorialized: "Ever-Normal Granary grain is released in spring and collected in autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he memorialized: "Ever-Normal Granary grain is released in spring and collected in autumn.

sentences.zh: 但收成有遲早，俗所謂青黃不接。

translations.literal: But harvests have early and late timing—what custom calls the green-yellow gap.
translations.idiomatic: But harvests come early or late—what people call the lean season between the old and new crops.

sentences.zh: 有司不揆緩急，甫春開糶，牙行囤積，吏胥侵漁。

translations.literal: Officials, without gauging urgency, opened granary sales at the very start of spring; broker houses hoarded grain, and clerks and runners embezzled.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, failing to weigh urgency, opened granary sales at the very start of spring; broker houses hoarded grain, and clerks and runners skimmed profits.

sentences.zh: 民未霑實惠，而穀已出逾額，且減價過多。

translations.literal: The people had not yet received real benefit, yet grain had already been released beyond quota, and prices were reduced too much.
translations.idiomatic: The people had not yet benefited, yet grain had already been released beyond quota at excessively low prices.

sentences.zh: 迨秋成買補，非存價觀望，冀省耗折；

translations.literal: When autumn harvest came to buy back and replenish, some held prices in hope of watching the market, seeking to save on loss and spoilage;
translations.idiomatic: When autumn came to buy back and replenish stocks, some hoarded grain waiting for prices to rise, hoping to save on spoilage;

sentences.zh: 即抑派爭買，致昂巿價。

translations.literal: or else compulsory allocation drove competing purchases, causing market prices to rise.
translations.idiomatic: or compulsory requisitioning drove frantic buying and drove market prices up.

sentences.zh: 請定浙東諸府以四月、浙西諸府以六月發糶，價平即止。

translations.literal: I request fixing granary sales for eastern Zhejiang prefectures in the fourth month and western Zhejiang prefectures in the sixth month, stopping when prices stabilize.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that eastern Zhejiang prefectures release granary grain in the fourth month and western Zhejiang in the sixth, stopping once prices stabilize.

sentences.zh: 」上以因時​​制宜，許之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor, because it suited the times, approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor approved it as a timely adaptation.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「浙江土狹民稠，全資溪湖容蓄灌溉，乃民間佔墾甚多。

translations.literal: He further memorialized: "Zhejiang's land is narrow and its population dense; it relies entirely on streams and lakes for storage and irrigation, yet the people have encroached and reclaimed greatly.
translations.idiomatic: He further memorialized: "Zhejiang's land is narrow and its population dense; it depends entirely on streams and lakes for storage and irrigation, yet much has been illegally reclaimed.

sentences.zh: 如餘杭南湖，會稽鑑湖，上虞夏蓋湖，餘姚汝仇湖，慈谿慈湖，向稱巨浸，今已彌望田疇，殊妨水利。

translations.literal: Such as Yuhang's South Lake, Kuaiji's Mirror Lake, Shangyu's Xiaga Lake, Yuyao's Ruchou Lake, and Cixi's Ci Lake—formerly called vast waters—now stretch as far as the eye can see with fields, greatly obstructing water conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: Lakes such as Yuhang's South Lake, Kuaiji's Mirror Lake, Shangyu's Xiaga Lake, Yuyao's Ruchou Lake, and Cixi's Ci Lake were once renowned expanses of water; now fields stretch as far as the eye can see, greatly impeding water management.

sentences.zh: 嗣後報墾田地，當責有司親勘，果非官湖，方准昇科；

translations.literal: Hereafter for reported reclaimed fields, responsible officials should be charged with personal inspection; only if truly not an official lake should grade upgrade be permitted;
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter, officials should personally inspect reported reclaimed land; tax assessment should be allowed only if the land is truly not an official lake;

sentences.zh: 查勘不實，嚴定處分。

translations.literal: if inspection is not truthful, strict punishment should be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: false inspections should incur strict penalties.

sentences.zh: 」下廷臣議行。

translations.literal: " It was referred to court ministers for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The court deliberated and implemented it.

sentences.zh: 秋，金、衢、嚴三府被水，旁溢杭、湖、紹三府，漂流人畜無算。

translations.literal: In autumn, the three prefectures of Jinhua, Quzhou, and Yanzhou were inundated; overflow spread to Hangzhou, Huzhou, and Shaoxing; drowned people and livestock were beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Jinhua, Quzhou, and Yanzhou were flooded; the waters spread to Hangzhou, Huzhou, and Shaoxing, drowning countless people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 思榘出臨江乾，處分賑事。

translations.literal: Siju went out to the Jianggan riverbank to manage relief affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Siju went to the riverbank to oversee relief efforts.

sentences.zh: 蕭山民洶洶欲渡江，思榘曰：「民飢當哺，閧則亂民耳。

translations.literal: People of Xiaoshan noisily wanted to cross the river; Siju said: "When the people are hungry they should be fed; if they riot they are merely disorderly people.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xiaoshan clamored to cross the river; Pan Siju said: "Hungry people must be fed; a riot merely makes them unruly mobs.

sentences.zh: 」嚴治之，自是無敢譁者。

translations.literal: " He strictly punished them, and from then on none dared make a disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: " He dealt with them firmly, and thereafter no one dared cause trouble.

sentences.zh: 思榘再疏聞，上諭曰：「今歲浙江災，巡撫常安有諱災之意，汝為其難矣。

translations.literal: Siju memorialized again to report; the Emperor instructed: "This year's disaster in Zhejiang—the governor Chang An had the intention of concealing the disaster; you undertook a difficult task.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Siju memorialized again with a report; the Emperor said: "This year's disaster in Zhejiang—the governor Chang An wished to conceal it; you took on a difficult assignment.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, appointed governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 河決鳳陽，潁、泗諸府州災尤重。

translations.literal: The river breached at Fengyang; the prefectures and departments of Ying and Si suffered especially heavy disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The river breached at Fengyang; the Ying and Si prefectures suffered especially severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 思榘請加賑，按行督察，犯風渡洪澤，舟幾覆。

translations.literal: Siju requested additional relief, toured to supervise, braved wind to cross Hongze Lake, and the boat nearly capsized.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Siju requested additional relief and toured to supervise; crossing Hongze Lake in a gale, his boat nearly capsized.

sentences.zh: 十二年，疏請調濟災區，略言：「鳳、潁民習惰窳。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he memorialized requesting adjustment and relief for disaster areas, stating in summary: "The people of Feng and Ying are accustomed to indolence and decay.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he memorialized requesting relief adjustments for the disaster zone, noting in summary: "The people of Feng and Ying are accustomed to idleness and neglect.

sentences.zh: 臣上年遍歷查勘，方冬水落，二麥已播種，而民不知耰鋤培壅。

translations.literal: Your servant last year traveled everywhere to inspect; just as winter water receded and winter wheat was sown, the people did not know how to hoe, weed, and mound soil.
translations.idiomatic: Last year I toured the region for inspection; as winter waters receded and winter wheat was sown, the people did not hoe, weed, or mound their fields.

sentences.zh: 所過村落，林木甚稀，蔬圃亦少。

translations.literal: In villages passed through, trees and forests were very sparse, and vegetable gardens also few.
translations.idiomatic: In villages I passed through, trees were sparse and vegetable gardens scarce.

sentences.zh: 臣令有司審察桑麻、蔬蓏，凡可佐小民日食之用者，隨宜試種。

translations.literal: Your servant ordered responsible officials to examine mulberry, hemp, vegetables, and fruits—whatever could supplement the daily food of common people—to be planted experimentally as suited.
translations.idiomatic: I ordered officials to assess mulberry, hemp, vegetables, and fruit—anything that could supplement the daily diet of common people—and to encourage experimental planting as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 鳳、潁地分三等，岡地最高，湖地稍低，灣地最下。

translations.literal: Feng and Ying land divides into three grades: ridge land is highest, lake land somewhat lower, and bay land lowest.
translations.idiomatic: Land in Feng and Ying falls into three grades: ridge land is highest, lake land somewhat lower, and bay land lowest.

sentences.zh: 灣地連大河，水發難施人力。

translations.literal: Bay land connects to great rivers; when water rises human effort is hard to apply.
translations.idiomatic: Bay land borders major rivers; when floods rise, little can be done by human effort.

sentences.zh: 湖地則外仰中低，積潦為湖，下流疏泄，即可涸出栽種。

translations.literal: Lake land slopes up at the edges and low in the center; accumulated flooding forms lakes; once lower streams are dredged and drained, land can be dried out for planting.
translations.idiomatic: Lake land rises at the edges and sinks in the center; water accumulates into ponds, but once downstream drainage is cleared, the land can be dried and planted.

sentences.zh: 岡地水雖不及，而絕少溝池，交秋缺雨，即患又乾。

translations.literal: Ridge land, though water does not reach it, has almost no ditches and ponds; when autumn arrives and rain lacks, drought affliction follows.
translations.idiomatic: Ridge land, though not flooded, has almost no ditches or ponds; when autumn brings little rain, drought follows at once.
