sentences.zh: 間有傍山麓而為陂塘，如壽州安豐塘、懷遠郭陂塘、鳳陽六塘，均應及時修築。

translations.literal: Occasionally there are reservoirs beside mountain foothills, such as Shouzhou's Anfeng Pool, Huaiyuan's Guo Reservoir, and Fengyang's Six Pools—all should be repaired and built in timely fashion.
translations.idiomatic: Here and there reservoirs lie at mountain foothills, such as Shouzhou's Anfeng Pool, Huaiyuan's Guo Reservoir, and Fengyang's Six Pools—all should be repaired promptly.

sentences.zh: 與其因災動帑鉅萬，何如平時酌動數百金陸續培治。

translations.literal: Rather than because of disaster mobilizing treasury funds in tens of thousands, how much better to allot several hundred taels in normal times for gradual repair and maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: Rather than spending tens of thousands from the treasury after disasters strike, it is better to allocate a few hundred taels in normal times for gradual upkeep.

sentences.zh: 民間減荒歉，多收成，朝廷亦省帑金。

translations.literal: Among the people famine and poor harvest are reduced, harvests increase, and the court also saves treasury funds.
translations.idiomatic: The people would suffer fewer bad harvests and enjoy greater yields, and the court would save treasury funds as well.

sentences.zh: 縱遇偏災，亦可以工代賑。

translations.literal: Even if partial disaster is encountered, relief through labor can also be applied.
translations.idiomatic: Even when localized disasters occur, labor projects can serve as relief.

sentences.zh: 鳳、潁民好轉徙，豐年秋成事畢，二麥已種，輒攜家外出，春熟方歸。

translations.literal: The people of Feng and Ying are fond of moving about; when the autumn harvest of a prosperous year is done and winter wheat is sown, they promptly take their families away and return only when spring crops ripen.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Feng and Ying are prone to wandering; after a good autumn harvest, once winter wheat is sown, they take their families away and return only when spring crops ripen.

sentences.zh: 遇災留一二人在家領賑，餘又潛往鄰境。

translations.literal: When disaster strikes they leave one or two people at home to receive relief, while the rest secretly go to neighboring districts.
translations.idiomatic: During disasters they leave one or two people at home to collect relief while the rest secretly slip into neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 俗謂在家領賑為大糧，在外留養為小糧，沿途資送為行糧，至有一家領三糧者。

translations.literal: Custom calls relief received at home "major grain," support maintained outside "minor grain," and travel assistance along the road "travel grain"—some households receive all three types of relief.
translations.idiomatic: They call home relief "major grain," support kept elsewhere "minor grain," and travel allowances "travel grain"—some families collect all three.

sentences.zh: 本業拋荒，人無固志。

translations.literal: Their own occupations are abandoned to lie fallow; people have no settled purpose.
translations.idiomatic: Their fields lie abandoned and the people lack any settled will to remain.

sentences.zh: 應令有司嚴察，流民過境，實係被災，方准資送；

translations.literal: Responsible officials should be ordered to investigate strictly; wandering people passing through should receive travel assistance only if truly disaster-stricken;
translations.idiomatic: Officials should investigate strictly; wandering people should receive travel assistance only if genuinely disaster-stricken;

sentences.zh: 藉端生事者究懲。

translations.literal: those who seize pretexts to cause trouble should be thoroughly punished.
translations.idiomatic: those who exploit the situation should be thoroughly punished.

sentences.zh: 」奏入，上諭曰：「此乃固本之事，歷來無有言及此者。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, the Emperor instructed: "This is a matter of strengthening the foundation; never before has anyone spoken of this.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, the Emperor said: "This strengthens the foundation of society—no one has raised this before.

sentences.zh: 朕甚嘉悅焉！

translations.literal: I am greatly pleased and delighted!
translations.idiomatic: I am deeply pleased!

sentences.zh: 尋調福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to governor of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to governor of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 未行，疏請安徽學田、囚田、義田三項，視江蘇免學租例，予以蠲免。

translations.literal: Before departing, he memorialized requesting that three categories in Anhui—school fields, prisoner fields, and charity fields—following Jiangsu's precedent of exempting school rents, be granted remission.
translations.idiomatic: Before departing, he memorialized asking that Anhui's school fields, prisoner fields, and charity fields be exempted from rent, following Jiangsu's precedent.

sentences.zh: 下軍機大臣察議，以江蘇無免學租例，上責思榘沽名幹譽，博去後之思，命出資修涿州城工示罰。

translations.literal: It was referred to Grand Council ministers for investigation and deliberation; since Jiangsu had no precedent for exempting school rents, the Emperor rebuked Siju for seeking reputation and acclaim, currying posthumous remembrance, and ordered him to contribute funds to repair Zhuozhou city walls as punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Council investigated; since Jiangsu had no such exemption precedent, the Emperor rebuked Pan Siju for grandstanding and seeking posthumous praise, and ordered him to fund repairs to Zhuozhou's city walls as punishment.

sentences.zh: 十三年，疏言：「福建自乾隆元年至十一年積欠錢糧，正設法清釐。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, he memorialized: "Fujian's accumulated arrears in taxes and grain from the first to the eleventh year of Qianlong are now being cleared by devised methods.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he memorialized: "Fujian's accumulated tax and grain arrears from Qianlong 1 to 11 are now being cleared.

sentences.zh: 民間田業授受，往往不及推糧過割。

translations.literal: Among the people, when farmland is transferred, tax reassignment often fails to keep pace.
translations.idiomatic: When farmland changes hands among the people, tax reassignment often fails to keep pace.

sentences.zh: 糧從田出，既有賠糧之戶；

translations.literal: Grain follows the field; there are households that pay compensation grain;
translations.idiomatic: Tax liability follows the land; some households pay compensation for others' taxes;

sentences.zh: 即有無糧之田，豈可使得業者任其脫漏，無業者代其追比？

translations.literal: yet there are also fields without grain—how can those who hold land be allowed to evade, while those without land are compelled to pay on their behalf?
translations.idiomatic: yet some fields carry no tax liability—how can landowners evade payment while landless people are forced to pay on their behalf?

sentences.zh: 當飭有司確察，務使糧歸於田。

translations.literal: Officials should be ordered to investigate thoroughly, striving to ensure grain obligations return to the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Officials should investigate thoroughly and ensure tax liability follows the land.

sentences.zh: 」十四年，复疏言：「臣清察積欠，一在屯田戶名不清，一在寺田租賦不一。

translations.literal: " In the fourteenth year, he again memorialized: "Your servant's clearing of accumulated arrears finds two problems: first, garrison-farmland household names are unclear; second, temple-field rents and levies are inconsistent.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourteenth year he again memorialized: "In clearing accumulated arrears I found two problems: unclear names on garrison-farmland registers, and inconsistent temple-field rents."

sentences.zh: 自順治間裁併衛所，名雖軍戶，實係民耕，乃糧冊仍列故軍姓名，致難催比，應令覈實更正。

translations.literal: Since the Shunzhi-era merger of guards and posts, though called military households, they are in fact civilian cultivators, yet tax registers still list old military names, making collection difficult—they should be verified and corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Since guards and posts were merged in the Shunzhi reign, the so-called military households are in fact civilian farmers, yet tax registers still list old military names, impeding collection—they should be verified and corrected.

sentences.zh: 寺田始自明季，僧、民相雜，輒稱寺廢僧逃，藉詞逋賦，應令分析寺已廢者，官為經理。

translations.literal: Temple fields began in the late Ming; monks and common people intermingled, often claiming temples abandoned and monks fled as pretext to evade levies—those whose temples are already defunct should be analyzed and managed by officials.
translations.idiomatic: Temple fields date to the late Ming; monks and laypeople intermingled, often claiming abandoned temples and fleeing monks to evade taxes—defunct temples should be identified and managed by officials.

sentences.zh: 」上命實力為之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered it done with real effort.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor ordered that it be vigorously pursued.

sentences.zh: 別疏言：「福州城外西湖為東晉郡守嚴高所開，週二十餘裡，蓄水溉田，年久淤墊。

translations.literal: In a separate memorial he stated: "West Lake outside Fuzhou was opened by Yan Gao, prefect of the Eastern Jin, with a circumference of over twenty li, storing water to irrigate fields; over the years it silted and filled.
translations.idiomatic: In a separate memorial he stated: "West Lake outside Fuzhou was excavated by Eastern Jin prefect Yan Gao, with a circumference of over twenty li to store water for irrigation; over time it silted up.

sentences.zh: 臣勸導疏濬，並築堤建閘。

translations.literal: Your servant encouraged and guided dredging, and also built dikes and sluice gates.
translations.idiomatic: I encouraged dredging and also built dikes and sluice gates.

sentences.zh: 又福清郎官港、法海埔俱有海灘淤地，臣令築堤招墾，得地二千一百餘畝。

translations.literal: Also at Fuqing's Langguan Harbor and Fahai Shoal there were silted tidal flats; your servant ordered dikes built and reclamation encouraged, gaining over twenty-one hundred mu of land.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuqing's Langguan Harbor and Fahai Shoal I ordered dikes built and reclamation encouraged, gaining over 2,100 mu of land.

sentences.zh: 」上獎諭之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor praised and commended him.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor commended him with praise.

sentences.zh: 思榘蒞政精勤，晝見官屬，夜披案牘。

translations.literal: Siju administered with meticulous diligence, receiving subordinates by day and reviewing case documents by night.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Siju governed with tireless diligence, meeting officials by day and reviewing documents by night.

sentences.zh: 旱潦必撫卹。

translations.literal: In drought or flood he always provided relief and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: In drought or flood he always provided relief.

sentences.zh: 民獷，以鬥訟相尚，多去為盜，廉得主名，飭有司捕治。

translations.literal: The people were fierce, valuing litigation and quarreling, many turning to banditry; once he knew the ringleaders' names, he ordered officials to arrest and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: The people were unruly, prone to litigation and banditry; once he learned the ringleaders' names, he ordered officials to arrest them.

sentences.zh: 又以農隙巡行海防，週閱戰艦。

translations.literal: He also used intervals in the farming season to tour coastal defenses and inspect warships.
translations.idiomatic: During farming lulls he toured coastal defenses and inspected warships.

sentences.zh: 朔望入書院與諸生講說經藝，如是者以為常。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth of each month he entered the academy to lecture students on the classics—he made this his regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth of each month he lectured students on the classics at the academy—a routine he never missed.

sentences.zh: 積勞疾作不少止。

translations.literal: Accumulated overwork brought illness, yet he did not rest in the least.
translations.idiomatic: Overwork brought on illness, yet he scarcely rested.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he died.

sentences.zh: 上命用江蘇巡撫徐士林例，祀京師賢良祠。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered that the precedent of Jiangsu Governor Xu Shilin be followed, enshrining him in the Capital Shrine of Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered him enshrined in the Capital Shrine of Worthies, following the precedent of Jiangsu Governor Xu Shilin.

sentences.zh: 予卹視一品，賜祭葬，諡敏惠。

translations.literal: Consolation gifts were granted as for the first rank; sacrificial rites and burial were bestowed; posthumous name Minhui.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted first-rank mourning honors, imperial rites of sacrifice and burial, and the posthumous name Minhui.

sentences.zh: =胡寶瑔=胡寶瑔，字泰舒，江南歙縣人。

translations.literal: Hu Baozhan, courtesy name Taishu, a native of She County in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Baozhan, courtesy name Taishu, was a native of She County in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 父廷對，嘗官婁縣訓導，因居青浦。

translations.literal: His father Tingdui once served as instructor of Lou County and therefore lived in Qingpu.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tingdui had served as instructor of Lou County and settled in Qingpu.

sentences.zh: 寶泉，雍正元年舉人。

translations.literal: Baozhan passed the provincial examination in the first year of Yongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Baozhan passed the provincial examination in the first year of Yongzheng.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，考授內閣中書，充軍機處章京。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, selected by examination as Secretariat drafter and appointed clerk of the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianlong he was selected by examination as a Secretariat drafter and appointed a Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 六年，大學士查郎阿、侍郎阿里袞清察黑龍江、吉林烏喇開墾地畝，以寶瑔從。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Grand Secretary Zhalang'a and Vice Minister Aligun inspected and cleared reclaimed land acreage in Heilongjiang and Jilin Wula, with Baozhan accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Grand Secretary Zhalang'a and Vice Minister Aligun inspected reclaimed land in Heilongjiang and Jilin Wula, with Hu Baozhan accompanying them.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷侍讀，考選福建道御史。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, transferred to reader-in-waiting and selected by examination as censor of the Fujian circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to reader-in-waiting and selected as censor of the Fujian circuit.

sentences.zh: 是歲直隸旱，上命治賑。

translations.literal: That year Zhili suffered drought; the Emperor ordered relief measures.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhili suffered drought, and the Emperor ordered relief.

sentences.zh: 寶瑔疏言：「直隸被旱，民多流亡，請敕總督宣示上意，使民靜以待賑。

translations.literal: Baozhan memorialized: "Zhili has suffered drought; many people have fled; I request an edict to the governor-general proclaiming the Emperor's intent, so the people remain calm and await relief.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Baozhan memorialized: "Zhili has suffered drought and many have fled; I ask that the governor-general proclaim the Emperor's intent so the people remain calm and await relief.

sentences.zh: 流民原歸耕而無力得歸者，資送還裡，俾及時藝麥，於來歲民食有益。

translations.literal: Wandering people who originally wished to return to farming but lacked means to return should be assisted home, enabling timely planting of wheat, which will benefit the people's food supply next year.
translations.idiomatic: Those who wish to return home but cannot afford the journey should be assisted back so they can plant wheat in time, benefiting next year's food supply.

sentences.zh: 」九年，上命大學士訥親閱河南、山東、江南諸省營伍，寶瑔疏言：「營伍積玩，器械堅脆，糧馬盈虧，各處不一。

translations.literal: " In the ninth year, the Emperor ordered Grand Secretary Neqin to inspect military camps in Henan, Shandong, Jiangnan, and other provinces; Baozhan memorialized: "Camps have long grown slack; the sturdiness of weapons, the surplus or deficit of rations and horses—all differ from place to place.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth year the Emperor ordered Grand Secretary Neqin to inspect troops in Henan, Shandong, Jiangnan, and other provinces; Hu Baozhan memorialized: "Troops have grown lax; weapons, rations, and horses vary in condition from place to place.

sentences.zh: 勢必聞風修整買補，不肖營員或藉端苛派，或坐扣月糧，請敕督撫提鎮嚴飭查察。

translations.literal: Upon hearing of the inspection they will surely repair and replace equipment; unworthy camp officers may seize the occasion for harsh levies or deduct monthly rations—I request an edict to governors-general, governors, generals, and commanders to strictly order investigation.
translations.idiomatic: When the inspection is announced they will rush to repair equipment; unscrupulous officers may use the occasion for harsh levies or deduct rations—I ask that governors-general, governors, and military commanders be ordered to investigate strictly.

sentences.zh: 」十年，山東、江南水災。

translations.literal: " In the tenth year, Shandong and Jiangnan suffered flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: " In the tenth year Shandong and Jiangnan were flooded.

sentences.zh: 寶瑔疏言：「方冬水涸，應勸諭農民引流赴壑，俾田不久浸，以便春耕，尤當預防蝻子。

translations.literal: Baozhan memorialized: "Just as winter water recedes, farmers should be urged to channel water into gullies, so fields are not long submerged and spring plowing is facilitated; locust nymphs especially should be guarded against in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Baozhan memorialized: "As winter waters recede, farmers should be urged to drain fields into gullies so land is not long submerged and spring plowing can proceed; locust nymphs should be guarded against in particular.

sentences.zh: 」諸疏皆議行。

translations.literal: " All these memorials were deliberated upon and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: " All these memorials were approved and implemented.

sentences.zh: 十一年，轉戶科給事中，遷順天府府丞。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, transferred to supervising secretary of the Revenue Section and promoted to vice prefect of Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was transferred to supervising secretary of the Revenue Section and promoted to vice prefect of Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大學士傅恆視師金川，以寶瑔從。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Fu Heng directed troops in Jinchuan, with Baozhan accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Fu Heng commanded troops in Jinchuan, with Hu Baozhan accompanying him.

sentences.zh: 授府尹，歷宗人府丞、左副都御史。

translations.literal: Appointed prefect, he successively served as vice director of the Imperial Clan Court and Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed prefect, he served successively as vice director of the Imperial Clan Court and Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 擢兵部侍郎，兼府尹如故。

translations.literal: Promoted to Vice Minister of War, he continued concurrently as prefect as before.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to Vice Minister of War, he continued concurrently as prefect.

sentences.zh: 河南民傅毓俊告張天重謀逆，遣寶瑔按治，毓俊服誣，論如律。

translations.literal: A Henan commoner Fu Yujun accused Zhang Tianzhong of plotting rebellion; Baozhan was dispatched to investigate; Yujun confessed to false accusation and was sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: A Henan commoner named Fu Yujun accused Zhang Tianzhong of plotting rebellion; Hu Baozhan was dispatched to investigate; Yujun confessed to false accusation and was sentenced accordingly.

sentences.zh: 十七年，署山西巡撫，十八年，實授。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, acting governor of Shanxi; in the eighteenth year, substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he served as acting governor of Shanxi; in the eighteenth year he received substantive appointment.

sentences.zh: 撫饑民，理冤獄，劾貪吏，整關隘隄防，諸政並舉。

translations.literal: He comforted famine victims, rectified wrongful cases, impeached corrupt officials, and restored passes, forts, and dikes—all policies were pursued together.
translations.idiomatic: He relieved famine victims, rectified wrongful cases, impeached corrupt officials, and restored passes and dikes—pursuing all these policies at once.

sentences.zh: 尋調湖南。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 十九年，奏言：「郴、桂二州銅鉛礦委員董理，一年而代。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, he memorialized: "The copper and lead mines of Chen and Gui prefectures are supervised by commissioners who serve one year and are replaced.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he memorialized: "The copper and lead mines of Chen and Gui prefectures are managed by commissioners who serve one year and are replaced.

sentences.zh: 礦為弊藪，代者必數月乃能明察。

translations.literal: Mines are a nest of corruption; replacements require several months before they can see clearly.
translations.idiomatic: Mines are breeding grounds for corruption; new commissioners need several months before they understand the situation.

sentences.zh: 此數月中，欺矇隱漏，已自不少。

translations.literal: In these several months, deception, concealment, and leakage are already considerable.
translations.idiomatic: In those months deception and leakage already cause considerable losses.

sentences.zh: 請仿台灣、瓊州例，令新舊協辦數月。

translations.literal: I request following the Taiwan and Qiongzhou precedent, ordering old and new commissioners to assist together for several months.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that we follow the Taiwan and Qiongzhou precedent and have outgoing and incoming commissioners work together for several months.

sentences.zh: 」得旨允行。

translations.literal: " Imperial assent was received and it was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor approved and it was implemented.

sentences.zh: 二十年，調江西。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, transferred to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was transferred to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，疏言：「廣信銅塘山勘明無可墾之地，無可用之材，無可煎之礦，請永行封禁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, he memorialized: "Investigation of Guangxin's Tongtang Mountain has established that there is no land worth reclaiming, no usable timber, and no mineable ore—I request permanent closure and prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he memorialized: "Investigation has shown Guangxin's Tongtang Mountain has no reclaimable land, usable timber, or minable ore—I ask that it be permanently closed.

sentences.zh: 」二十二年，疏言：「豐城堤工最要，石隄官修，土堤民修，向設里夫，行之已久。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-second year, he memorialized: "Fengcheng's dike works are most important; stone dikes are repaired by the government, earthen dikes by the people; village corvée laborers were formerly established and this has long been in practice.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twenty-second year he memorialized: "Fengcheng's dikes are critically important; stone dikes are repaired by the government and earthen dikes by the people; village corvée labor was long established for this purpose.

sentences.zh: 黠者避役，貧者誤工，復改為折徵。

translations.literal: The cunning evaded labor duty, the poor failed at their tasks, and the system was changed again to commutation payments.
translations.idiomatic: The shrewd evaded labor, the poor defaulted, and the system was changed to cash commutation.

sentences.zh: 請按田均堤，附漕糧徵收。

translations.literal: I request assessing dikes per field and collecting as an attachment to grain-transport taxes.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that dike obligations be assessed per field and collected with grain-transport taxes.

sentences.zh: 有田始有糧，有糧始有夫。

translations.literal: Only with fields is there grain tax; only with grain tax is there corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: Fields produce tax obligations, and tax obligations produce labor duties.

sentences.zh: 圩長無從侵冒，工程乃可永固。

translations.literal: Polder headmen would have no means to embezzle, and the works could be permanently secure.
translations.idiomatic: Polder overseers would have no opportunity to embezzle, and the works would endure.

sentences.zh: 」均如所請行。

translations.literal: " All was carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved and implemented.

sentences.zh: 復調河南。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred back to Henan.

sentences.zh: 河屢決，山東、河南、安徽諸州縣多積水。

translations.literal: The river burst its banks repeatedly; many prefectures and counties in Shandong, Henan, and Anhui had standing water.
translations.idiomatic: The river broke repeatedly, and many counties in Shandong, Henan, and Anhui were flooded.

sentences.zh: 上遣侍郎裘曰修會諸省督撫疏治。

translations.literal: The Emperor dispatched Vice Minister Qiu Yuexiu to join the governors-general and governors of the provinces in dredging and treatment.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent Vice Minister Qiu Yuexiu to work with provincial governors on dredging and drainage.

sentences.zh: 寶瑔與曰修會勘，疏言：「河南幹河有四：賈魯、惠濟、渦河、巴溝。

translations.literal: Baozhan joined Yuexiu in inspection and memorialized: "Henan has four main rivers: Jia Lu, Huiji, Wo River, and Bagou.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Baozhan joined Qiu Yuexiu in surveying the works and memorialized: "Henan has four trunk channels: the Jia Lu, Huiji, Wo, and Bagou.

sentences.zh: 巴溝在商丘為豐樂河，在夏邑為響河，在永城為巴河。

translations.literal: Bagou at Shangqiu is the Fengle River, at Xiayi the Xiang River, and at Yongcheng the Ba River.
translations.idiomatic: The Bagou channel is called the Fengle River at Shangqiu, the Xiang River at Xiayi, and the Ba River at Yongcheng.

sentences.zh: 今擬疏濬加寬深，以最低處為率。

translations.literal: It is now proposed to dredge and widen and deepen them, taking the lowest point as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: They propose dredging them wider and deeper, using the lowest sections as the benchmark.

sentences.zh: 惠濟上游在中牟、祥符諸縣，下游在柘城、鹿邑諸縣，今亦擬加寬深，以六七丈為率。

translations.literal: Huiji's upper reaches are in Zhongmou, Xiangfu, and other counties; its lower reaches in Zhecheng, Luyi, and other counties; it too is proposed to be widened and deepened, taking six or seven zhang as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: The upper Huiji runs through Zhongmou, Xiangfu, and neighboring counties and the lower reaches through Zhecheng, Luyi, and others; it too should be widened and deepened to about six or seven zhang.

sentences.zh: 賈魯自中牟以下有惠濟分流，自硃仙鎮以下，截沙灣，塞決口，拓舊堤。

translations.literal: Below Zhongmou the Jia Lu has a Huiji diversion; below Zhuxian Town, cut off Shawan, block the breach, and expand the old dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Below Zhongmou the Jia Lu splits into the Huiji; below Zhuxian Town the Shawan cutoff should be completed, the breach sealed, and the old dikes enlarged.

sentences.zh: 渦河自通許青岡為燕城河，上游應加寬，下游應加深。

translations.literal: The Wo River from Qinggang in Tongxu is the Yancheng River; the upper reaches should be widened and the lower deepened.
translations.idiomatic: The Wo channel from Qinggang in Tongxu forms the Yancheng River; the upper course should be widened and the lower deepened.

sentences.zh: 鹿邑以下本已寬深，當增築月堤。

translations.literal: Below Luyi it is already wide and deep; crescent dikes should be added.
translations.idiomatic: Below Luyi the channel is already wide and deep; additional crescent dikes should be built.

sentences.zh: 支河應濬者，商丘北沙、洪溝二河為支中之幹，餘大小支河，分要工、次工、緩工，次第興修。

translations.literal: Among tributaries requiring dredging, the Beisha and Honggou rivers at Shangqiu are the main lines among branches; remaining large and small tributaries should be divided into priority work, secondary work, and deferred work, and repaired in order.
translations.idiomatic: Of the tributaries needing dredging, the Beisha and Honggou at Shangqiu are the chief branches; the rest, large and small, should be ranked as priority, secondary, or deferred projects and repaired in sequence.

sentences.zh: 」二十三年，上諭曰：「河南災區積困，寶瑔不辭勞瘁，能體朕意，盡力調劑，以蘇窮民，甚可嘉也！

translations.literal: " In the twenty-third year, the Emperor instructed: "Henan's disaster areas have long been exhausted; Baozhan spares no toil, can comprehend My intent, exerts full effort in adjustment and relief, to revive the destitute people—highly commendable!
translations.idiomatic: " In the twenty-third year the Emperor said: "Henan's disaster zones have suffered long; Hu Baozhan has spared no effort, has understood My intent, worked tirelessly to provide relief, and revived the poorest people—this is highly commendable!

sentences.zh: 」尋加太子少傅。

translations.literal: " Soon he was given the additional title of Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: " He was soon made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 諸工皆竟，上御制中州治河碑，褒寶瑔、曰修，語並見曰修傳。

translations.literal: When all works were completed, the Emperor composed in his own hand the Central Plains River Control stele, praising Baozhan and Yuexiu; the text is also in Yuexiu's biography.
translations.idiomatic: When the works were finished, the Emperor personally composed a stele on Central Plains river control, praising Hu Baozhan and Qiu Yuexiu; the inscription appears in Qiu Yuexiu's biography.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，疏言：「河北諸水，衛河為大。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, he memorialized: "Among the waters north of the Yellow River, the Wei River is greatest.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he memorialized: "Of the waterways north of the Yellow River, the Wei River is the greatest.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，河督嵇曾筠於汲、淇、濬、湯陰、內黃諸縣建草壩二十六，今已漸次淤墊。

translations.literal: During Yongzheng, River Director Ji Zengjun built twenty-six brush dams in Ji, Qi, Jun, Tangyin, Neihuang, and other counties; they have now gradually silted up.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng reign River Director Ji Zengjun built twenty-six brush weirs in Ji, Qi, Jun, Tangyin, Neihuang, and neighboring counties; they have gradually silted over.

sentences.zh: 臣相度疏築，俾一律深通。

translations.literal: Your subject has surveyed and proposes dredging and construction so all will be uniformly deep and open.
translations.idiomatic: I have surveyed the channel and propose dredging and building works so it runs uniformly deep and clear.

sentences.zh: 請定為三年一小修、五年一大修。

translations.literal: I request fixing minor repairs every three years and major repairs every five years.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that minor repairs be scheduled every three years and major repairs every five.

sentences.zh: 」上可其奏。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 是冬，調江西。

translations.literal: That winter, he was transferred to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was transferred to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，河決楊橋。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, the river breached at Yangqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the river broke at Yangqiao.

sentences.zh: 復調還河南。

translations.literal: He was again transferred back to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred back to Henan.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「賈魯、惠濟二河在中牟境內，逼近楊橋。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Jia Lu and Huiji rivers within Zhongmou territory approach Yangqiao closely.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The Jia Lu and Huiji channels run through Zhongmou near Yangqiao.

sentences.zh: 賈魯受黃水南徙，至祥符時家岡仍入故道，今已成河。

translations.literal: The Jia Lu received Yellow River water moving south; at Shifu, when it reached Shijiagang it still entered the old course, and now has become a river.
translations.idiomatic: The Jia Lu took Yellow River water flowing south; at Shifu it rejoined its old bed at Shijiagang and has now formed a full channel.

sentences.zh: 當將分者截之使合，淺者疏之使深，兩岸多挑渠港，增築堤堰，自成河道。

translations.literal: Where it has divided, cut off and join; where shallow, dredge to deepen; on both banks dig many channels and harbors, add dikes and weirs, forming a river course of its own.
translations.idiomatic: Split sections should be cut off and merged, shallow stretches dredged deeper, channel harbors dug on both banks, and dikes and weirs added to form a proper waterway.

sentences.zh: 惠濟自兩閘至岡頭橋已淤斷，而岡頭橋至十里坡賈魯河不過四五里。

translations.literal: Huiji from the two sluices to Gangtou Bridge is already silted and cut off, while from Gangtou Bridge to Shilipo on the Jia Lu River is no more than four or five li.
translations.idiomatic: The Huiji from the two sluice gates to Gangtou Bridge is silted shut, yet Gangtou Bridge is only four or five li from the Jia Lu at Shilipo.

sentences.zh: 即於十里坡建滾水壩，導由岡頭橋入惠濟，以分賈魯之勢，而惠濟亦復故道。

translations.literal: At once build a spillway dam at Shilipo, guide water through Gangtou Bridge into Huiji, to divide the force of the Jia Lu, and Huiji too will resume its old course.
translations.idiomatic: A spillway dam should be built at Shilipo to divert water through Gangtou Bridge into the Huiji, easing pressure on the Jia Lu and restoring the Huiji to its old course.

sentences.zh: 」上褒為事半功倍。

translations.literal: " The Emperor praised it as achieving double the result with half the effort.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor praised the plan as highly efficient.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，寶瑔疾作，請解任。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Baozhan fell ill and requested release from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Hu Baozhan fell ill and asked to resign.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「此奏甚非朕之所望，安心靜攝，以慰廑念。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed: "This memorial is far from what I hoped for; rest in peace and care for your health, to ease My deep concern.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "This is not what I wished to hear; rest quietly and regain your health to set My mind at ease.

sentences.zh: 」遣醫馳驛診視。

translations.literal: " He dispatched a physician by express relay to examine and treat him.
translations.idiomatic: " He sent a physician by relay post to attend him.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「溝渠與河道相為表裡，臣於二十三年河工告竣，即督令州縣經理溝洫，每一州縣中開溝自十數道至百數十道，長自里許至數十里，寬自數尺至數丈，皆以足資蓄洩為度。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Ditches and channels complement river courses inwardly and outwardly; after the twenty-third-year river works were completed, I immediately supervised the prefectures and counties in managing drainage ditches; in each prefecture and county trenches were opened from more than ten to more than a hundred channels, from about a li to several tens of li in length, from several chi to several zhang in width—all measured to suffice for storage and discharge.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Ditches and rivers work as inner and outer defenses; when the twenty-third-year river works were finished I ordered the prefectures and counties to maintain drainage channels—anywhere from a dozen to more than a hundred per district, from about a li to dozens of li long and from a few chi to several zhang wide, all sized to store or drain water as needed.

sentences.zh: 驛路通衢，並就道傍開濬，雖道裡綿亙，而分戶承挑，民易為力。

translations.literal: Along post roads and thoroughfares, digging and dredging was also done beside the roads; though the distance extended for li on end, households shared the labor by assignment, so the people found it easy to supply effort.
translations.idiomatic: Along post roads and main highways channels were dug beside the road; though the work stretched for miles, assigning households to sections made the labor manageable.

sentences.zh: 自是每歲或春融，或農隙，隨時加濬寬深。

translations.literal: From then on, each year whether at spring thaw or in gaps between farm work, widening and deepening was added as occasion allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter each year, at spring thaw or between farming seasons, channels were widened and deepened as timing allowed.

sentences.zh: 」上深嘉之，並令直隸總督方觀承仿行。

translations.literal: " The Emperor deeply praised it and also ordered Zhili Governor-General Fang Guancheng to follow the example.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor highly commended the plan and ordered Zhili Governor-General Fang Guancheng to adopt the same approach.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，卒，加太子太保、兵部尚書，賜祭葬，諡恪靖。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, he died; was given the additional titles of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister of War, granted sacrificial rites and burial honors, posthumous name Kejing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he died and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister of War, granted state sacrifice and burial, and given the posthumous name Kejing.

sentences.zh: 遺疏請入籍青浦，許之。

translations.literal: In his deathbed memorial he requested enrollment in the household register at Qingpu; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In his final memorial he asked to be registered at Qingpu; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：那蘇圖、士林、恕、思榘皆以清節著，而超曾、寶瑔又濟之以勤敏。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Na Sutu, Shilin, Shu, and Siju were all noted for pure integrity, while Chaoceng and Baozhan further added diligence and alertness.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Na Sutu, Xu Shilin, Wang Shu, and Pan Siju were all known for upright integrity, while Yang Chaoceng and Hu Baozhan added diligence and quick competence.

sentences.zh: 恕論救災，寶瑔善行水，皆以民事為急。

translations.literal: Shu discoursed on disaster relief; Baozhan was skilled at water works; all took the people's affairs as urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shu wrote on disaster relief and Hu Baozhan was adept at water control; all put the people's welfare first.

sentences.zh: 顯佐定苗疆，有拊循之績。

translations.literal: Xian assisted in pacifying the Miao frontier and had achievements in comforting and guiding.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Xian helped pacify the Miao frontier and won credit for settling and soothing the people.

sentences.zh: 錫紱督漕運，所修舉似若瑣細，然皆當官之急務也。

translations.literal: Xifu supervised grain transport; what he undertook and promoted seemed perhaps trivial, yet all were urgent duties of office.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xifu oversaw grain transport; his initiatives seemed minor, yet all addressed pressing official responsibilities.

sentences.zh: 會一澤以道學，但微近名，遂貽後嗣之禍，恫哉！

translations.literal: Huiyi enriched others with Neo-Confucian learning, but was slightly close to seeking reputation, and thus bequeathed calamity to later generations—how alarming!
translations.idiomatic: Yin Huiyi spread Neo-Confucian learning, but bordered on self-promotion and brought disaster on his descendants—a warning indeed!
